{"parentUuid":"29128587-fdd2-41f1-8483-77c1cf1aaa21","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_8aq8yg125wcmubrpni1c0z2e","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a/src/io_layer.rs","content":"//! 可注入故障的 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 两个后端实现同一组原语，存储引擎不感知底层是真实文件还是模拟磁盘：\n//!\n//! * [`RealStorage`]：真实文件系统（`File::write_all` + `sync_all` = fsync）；\n//! * [`SimStorage`]：进程内“模拟磁盘”，显式区分**易失页缓存**与**稳定存储**，\n//!   可按 `(目标文件, 操作, 第几次)` 精确注入断电 / 半页写。\n//!\n//! # 模拟磁盘的崩溃语义\n//!\n//! 每次 write 只修改该挂载实例的易失缓存；`sync` 才把缓存整体下发到稳定存储。\n//! “断电”（[`FaultKind::CrashBefore`]）丢弃全部未同步缓存，稳定存储不变；\n//! “半页写”（[`FaultKind::TearWrite`]）只让本次写入的前 N 个字节落到稳定存储，\n//! 随后同样丢弃全部缓存——这正是掉电瞬间 4 KiB 页只持久化一部分的效果。\n//! 重新 [`SimDisk::storage`] 即相当于重新挂载：缓存清空、计数归零。\n\nuse std::cell::RefCell;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::rc::Rc;\n\nuse crate::format::{PAGE_SIZE, SUPER_FILE_SIZE};\n\n/// I/O 操作目标文件。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum Target {\n    /// 仅追加的数据文件 data.log。\n    Data,\n    /// 双页超级块文件 super.db。\n    Super,\n}\n\n/// I/O 操作种类。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum Op {\n    /// 数据文件追加 / 超级块槽位整页写入。\n    Write,\n    /// fsync。\n    Sync,\n}\n\n/// 注入的故障类型。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum FaultKind {\n    /// 操作执行前断电：所有未落盘缓存丢失，稳定存储保持原状。\n    CrashBefore,\n    /// 仅本次写入的前 `keep` 字节持久化，其余丢失，随后断电（半页写）。\n    TearWrite(usize),\n}\n\n/// 一条故障规则：对 `target` 的第 `nth` 个 `op` 操作（每次挂载从 1 开始计数）\n/// 注入 `kind`。规则一次性生效。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    pub target: Target,\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub nth: u64,\n    pub kind: FaultKind,\n}\n\nimpl FaultRule {\n    pub fn crash(target: Target, op: Op, nth: u64) -> Self {\n        FaultRule { target, op, nth, kind: FaultKind::CrashBefore }\n    }\n    pub fn tear(target: Target, nth: u64, keep: usize) -> Self {\n        FaultRule { target, op: Op::Write, nth, kind: FaultKind::TearWrite(keep) }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 存储引擎依赖的 I/O 原语。一次提交中的调用顺序见模块级文档。\npub trait Storage {\n    /// 读取数据文件全部字节（挂载时使用）。\n    fn read_data(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    /// 读取超级块文件全部字节（挂载时使用）。\n    fn read_super(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    /// 向数据文件末尾追加一次逻辑写入。\n    fn append_data(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// fsync 数据文件。\n    fn sync_data(&self) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 将整页（PAGE_SIZE）写入超级块指定槽位。\n    fn write_super_slot(&self, slot: usize, page: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// fsync 超级块文件。\n    fn sync_super(&self) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\n/// 模拟磁盘的稳定状态（可被多个“挂载实例”共享，模拟重挂载）。\nstruct SimDiskState {\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n    superfile: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 进程内模拟磁盘句柄。克隆廉价（内部引用计数）。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct SimDisk {\n    inner: Rc<RefCell<SimDiskState>>,\n}\n\nimpl SimDisk {\n    /// 新建一块“已分区但未格式化”的空盘：数据文件为空，超级块文件为\n    /// SUPER_FILE_SIZE 个零字节（零页对恢复而言是无效页）。\n    pub fn fresh() -> Self {\n        SimDisk {\n            inner: Rc::new(RefCell::new(SimDiskState {\n                data: Vec::new(),\n                superfile: vec![0u8; SUPER_FILE_SIZE],\n            })),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 用给定故障规则重新挂载（旧挂载的缓存天然不可见）。\n    pub fn storage(&self, rules: Vec<FaultRule>) -> SimStorage {\n        for r in &rules {\n            if matches!(r.kind, FaultKind::TearWrite(_)) && r.op != Op::Write {\n                panic!(\"TearWrite 只能注入写操作，规则: {r:?}\");\n            }\n        }\n        SimStorage {\n            disk: self.inner.clone(),\n            rules: RefCell::new(rules.into_iter().map(|r| (r, false)).collect()),\n            counts: RefCell::new(HashMap::new()),\n            data_cache: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),\n            super_cache: RefCell::new(None),\n        }\n    }\n\n    // —— 供测试直接篡改稳定存储（模拟盘外介质损坏 / 人工造数）——\n\n    pub fn stable_data(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        self.inner.borrow().data.clone()\n    }\n    pub fn stable_super(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        self.inner.borrow().superfile.clone()\n    }\n    pub fn set_stable_data(&self, data: Vec<u8>) {\n        self.inner.borrow_mut().data = data;\n    }\n    pub fn set_stable_super(&self, superfile: Vec<u8>) {\n        assert_eq!(superfile.len(), SUPER_FILE_SIZE);\n        self.inner.borrow_mut().superfile = superfile;\n    }\n    /// 就地修改稳定存储字节。\n    pub fn with_data<F: FnOnce(&mut Vec<u8>)>(&self, f: F) {\n        f(&mut self.inner.borrow_mut().data);\n    }\n    pub fn with_super<F: FnOnce(&mut Vec<u8>)>(&self, f: F) {\n        f(&mut self.inner.borrow_mut().superfile);\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一次“挂载”：持有独立的易失缓存、操作计数与故障规则。\npub struct SimStorage {\n    disk: Rc<RefCell<SimDiskState>>,\n    rules: RefCell<Vec<(FaultRule, bool)>>,\n    counts: RefCell<HashMap<(Target, Op), u64>>,\n    data_cache: RefCell<Vec<u8>>,\n    super_cache: RefCell<Option<(usize, Vec<u8>)>>,\n}\n\n/// 故障被触发时返回的 io::Error 内部错误，存储引擎据此与真实 I/O 错误区分。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct SimFaultError {\n    pub target: Target,\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub nth: u64,\n    pub kind: FaultKind,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for SimFaultError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"注入故障: {:?} 第 {} 个 {:?} -> {:?}\", self.target, self.nth, self.op, self.kind)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for SimFaultError {}\n\nimpl SimStorage {\n    /// 计数并检查本操作是否命中故障规则；命中则返回故障类型。\n    fn fire(&self, target: Target, op: Op) -> Option<FaultKind> {\n        let nth = {\n            let mut counts = self.counts.borrow_mut();\n            let e = counts.entry((target, op)).or_insert(0);\n            *e += 1;\n            *e\n        };\n        let mut rules = self.rules.borrow_mut();\n        for (rule, consumed) in rules.iter_mut() {\n            if !*consumed && rule.target == target && rule.op == op && rule.nth == nth {\n                *consumed = true;\n                return Some(rule.kind);\n            }\n        }\n        None\n    }\n\n    fn fault_err(&self, target: Target, op: Op, nth: u64, kind: FaultKind) -> io::Error {\n        io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, SimFaultError { target, op, nth, kind })\n    }\n\n    /// 断电：丢弃该挂载的全部易失缓存。\n    fn power_loss(&self) {\n        self.data_cache.borrow_mut().clear();\n        *self.super_cache.borrow_mut() = None;\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Storage for SimStorage {\n    fn read_data(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        Ok(self.disk.borrow().data.clone())\n    }\n\n    fn read_super(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        Ok(self.disk.borrow().superfile.clone())\n    }\n\n    fn append_data(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Data, Op::Write)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Data, Op::Write) {\n            match kind {\n                FaultKind::CrashBefore => {\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Data, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n                FaultKind::TearWrite(keep) => {\n                    // 掉电瞬间：本次追加只有前 keep 字节落盘，缓存全丢。\n                    let keep = keep.min(bytes.len());\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    let mut d = self.disk.borrow_mut();\n                    d.data.extend_from_slice(&bytes[..keep]);\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Data, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        self.data_cache.borrow_mut().extend_from_slice(bytes);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_data(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Data, Op::Sync)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Data, Op::Sync) {\n            self.power_loss();\n            return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Data, Op::Sync, nth, kind));\n        }\n        let pending = std::mem::take(&mut *self.data_cache.borrow_mut());\n        self.disk.borrow_mut().data.extend_from_slice(&pending);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_super_slot(&self, slot: usize, page: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        assert_eq!(page.len(), PAGE_SIZE, \"超级块写入必须恰好一页\");\n        assert!(slot < 2);\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Super, Op::Write)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Super, Op::Write) {\n            match kind {\n                FaultKind::CrashBefore => {\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Super, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n                FaultKind::TearWrite(keep) => {\n                    // 新页只落盘前 keep 字节（落在交替槽位，旧槽位不受影响）。\n                    let keep = keep.min(page.len());\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    let mut d = self.disk.borrow_mut();\n                    let pos = slot * PAGE_SIZE;\n                    d.superfile[pos..pos + keep].copy_from_slice(&page[..keep]);\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Super, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        self.super_cache.replace(Some((slot, page.to_vec())));\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_super(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Super, Op::Sync)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Super, Op::Sync) {\n            self.power_loss();\n            return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Super, Op::Sync, nth, kind));\n        }\n        if let Some((slot, page)) = self.super_cache.borrow_mut().take() {\n            let pos = slot * PAGE_SIZE;\n            let mut d = self.disk.borrow_mut();\n            d.superfile[pos..pos + PAGE_SIZE].copy_from_slice(&page);\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================ 真实文件后端 ============================\n\n/// 真实文件系统后端：数据文件以 O_APPEND 打开，超级块文件随机定位整页写。\npub struct RealStorage {\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    data: RefCell<File>,\n    superfile: RefCell<File>,\n}\n\nimpl RealStorage {\n    /// 在目录上挂载。要求目录与两个文件都已存在（先用 `format` 格式化）。\n    pub fn open(dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let data_path = dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE);\n        let super_path = dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE);\n        if !data_path.exists() || !super_path.exists() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"存储尚未格式化（缺少 data.log / super.db）\"));\n        }\n        let data = OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(&data_path)?;\n        let superfile = OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(&super_path)?;\n        Ok(RealStorage { dir: dir.to_path_buf(), data: RefCell::new(data), superfile: RefCell::new(superfile) })\n    }\n\n    /// 格式化：（重）建两个文件。数据文件截断为空；超级块文件先零填两页，\n    /// 随后由存储引擎把代次 0 的空超级块写入槽位 0。\n    pub fn create_files(dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;\n        let data = OpenOptions::new()\n            .create(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE))?;\n        data.sync_all()?;\n        let sf = OpenOptions::new()\n            .create(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE))?;\n        sf.set_len(SUPER_FILE_SIZE as u64)?;\n        sf.sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn dir(&self) -> &Path {\n        &self.dir\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Storage for RealStorage {\n    fn read_data(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let mut f = File::open(self.dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE))?;\n        let mut v = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut v)?;\n        Ok(v)\n    }\n\n    fn read_super(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let mut f = File::open(self.dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE))?;\n        let mut v = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut v)?;\n        Ok(v)\n    }\n\n    fn append_data(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.data.borrow_mut().write_all(bytes)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_data(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.data.borrow().sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn write_super_slot(&self, slot: usize, page: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        assert_eq!(page.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let mut f = self.superfile.borrow_mut();\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start((slot * PAGE_SIZE) as u64))?;\n        f.write_all(page)?;\n        // 复位到末尾不是必须的：超级块从不追加。\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_super(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.superfile.borrow().sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    /// 未同步的写在“断电”后必须全部丢失；sync 后的必须保留。\n    #[test]\n    fn crash_loses_only_unsynced_bytes() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        {\n            let s = disk.storage(vec![]);\n            s.append_data(b\"aaa\").unwrap();\n            s.sync_data().unwrap();\n            s.append_data(b\"bbb\").unwrap();\n            // 不 sync 直接丢弃挂载实例。\n        }\n        let s2 = disk.storage(vec![]);\n        assert_eq!(s2.read_data().unwrap(), b\"aaa\");\n    }\n\n    /// 半页写：只有前 keep 字节落盘。\n    #[test]\n    fn tear_write_persists_prefix_only() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        let rule = FaultRule::tear(Target::Data, 1, 2);\n        let s = disk.storage(vec![rule]);\n        let err = s.append_data(b\"abcdef\").unwrap_err();\n        assert!(err.get_ref().unwrap().is::<SimFaultError>());\n        assert_eq!(disk.stable_data(), b\"ab\");\n    }\n\n    /// 断电于 fsync 之前：整次提交的数据都不落盘。\n    #[test]\n    fn crash_before_sync_loses_whole_batch() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        let s = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Sync, 1)]);\n }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_284358ebc9fda3e32d230b44","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":5981,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":38712,"output_tokens":10782,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_8aq8yg125wcmubrpni1c0z2e":{"content":"//! 可注入故障的 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 两个后端实现同一组原语，存储引擎不感知底层是真实文件还是模拟磁盘：\n//!\n//! * [`RealStorage`]：真实文件系统（`File::write_all` + `sync_all` = fsync）；\n//! * [`SimStorage`]：进程内“模拟磁盘”，显式区分**易失页缓存**与**稳定存储**，\n//!   可按 `(目标文件, 操作, 第几次)` 精确注入断电 / 半页写。\n//!\n//! # 模拟磁盘的崩溃语义\n//!\n//! 每次 write 只修改该挂载实例的易失缓存；`sync` 才把缓存整体下发到稳定存储。\n//! “断电”（[`FaultKind::CrashBefore`]）丢弃全部未同步缓存，稳定存储不变；\n//! “半页写”（[`FaultKind::TearWrite`]）只让本次写入的前 N 个字节落到稳定存储，\n//! 随后同样丢弃全部缓存——这正是掉电瞬间 4 KiB 页只持久化一部分的效果。\n//! 重新 [`SimDisk::storage`] 即相当于重新挂载：缓存清空、计数归零。\n\nuse std::cell::RefCell;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::rc::Rc;\n\nuse crate::format::{PAGE_SIZE, SUPER_FILE_SIZE};\n\n/// I/O 操作目标文件。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum Target {\n    /// 仅追加的数据文件 data.log。\n    Data,\n    /// 双页超级块文件 super.db。\n    Super,\n}\n\n/// I/O 操作种类。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum Op {\n    /// 数据文件追加 / 超级块槽位整页写入。\n    Write,\n    /// fsync。\n    Sync,\n}\n\n/// 注入的故障类型。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum FaultKind {\n    /// 操作执行前断电：所有未落盘缓存丢失，稳定存储保持原状。\n    CrashBefore,\n    /// 仅本次写入的前 `keep` 字节持久化，其余丢失，随后断电（半页写）。\n    TearWrite(usize),\n}\n\n/// 一条故障规则：对 `target` 的第 `nth` 个 `op` 操作（每次挂载从 1 开始计数）\n/// 注入 `kind`。规则一次性生效。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    pub target: Target,\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub nth: u64,\n    pub kind: FaultKind,\n}\n\nimpl FaultRule {\n    pub fn crash(target: Target, op: Op, nth: u64) -> Self {\n        FaultRule { target, op, nth, kind: FaultKind::CrashBefore }\n    }\n    pub fn tear(target: Target, nth: u64, keep: usize) -> Self {\n        FaultRule { target, op: Op::Write, nth, kind: FaultKind::TearWrite(keep) }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 存储引擎依赖的 I/O 原语。一次提交中的调用顺序见模块级文档。\npub trait Storage {\n    /// 读取数据文件全部字节（挂载时使用）。\n    fn read_data(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    /// 读取超级块文件全部字节（挂载时使用）。\n    fn read_super(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    /// 向数据文件末尾追加一次逻辑写入。\n    fn append_data(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// fsync 数据文件。\n    fn sync_data(&self) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 将整页（PAGE_SIZE）写入超级块指定槽位。\n    fn write_super_slot(&self, slot: usize, page: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// fsync 超级块文件。\n    fn sync_super(&self) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\n/// 模拟磁盘的稳定状态（可被多个“挂载实例”共享，模拟重挂载）。\nstruct SimDiskState {\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n    superfile: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 进程内模拟磁盘句柄。克隆廉价（内部引用计数）。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct SimDisk {\n    inner: Rc<RefCell<SimDiskState>>,\n}\n\nimpl SimDisk {\n    /// 新建一块“已分区但未格式化”的空盘：数据文件为空，超级块文件为\n    /// SUPER_FILE_SIZE 个零字节（零页对恢复而言是无效页）。\n    pub fn fresh() -> Self {\n        SimDisk {\n            inner: Rc::new(RefCell::new(SimDiskState {\n                data: Vec::new(),\n                superfile: vec![0u8; SUPER_FILE_SIZE],\n            })),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 用给定故障规则重新挂载（旧挂载的缓存天然不可见）。\n    pub fn storage(&self, rules: Vec<FaultRule>) -> SimStorage {\n        for r in &rules {\n            if matches!(r.kind, FaultKind::TearWrite(_)) && r.op != Op::Write {\n                panic!(\"TearWrite 只能注入写操作，规则: {r:?}\");\n            }\n        }\n        SimStorage {\n            disk: self.inner.clone(),\n            rules: RefCell::new(rules.into_iter().map(|r| (r, false)).collect()),\n            counts: RefCell::new(HashMap::new()),\n            data_cache: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),\n            super_cache: RefCell::new(None),\n        }\n    }\n\n    // —— 供测试直接篡改稳定存储（模拟盘外介质损坏 / 人工造数）——\n\n    pub fn stable_data(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        self.inner.borrow().data.clone()\n    }\n    pub fn stable_super(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        self.inner.borrow().superfile.clone()\n    }\n    pub fn set_stable_data(&self, data: Vec<u8>) {\n        self.inner.borrow_mut().data = data;\n    }\n    pub fn set_stable_super(&self, superfile: Vec<u8>) {\n        assert_eq!(superfile.len(), SUPER_FILE_SIZE);\n        self.inner.borrow_mut().superfile = superfile;\n    }\n    /// 就地修改稳定存储字节。\n    pub fn with_data<F: FnOnce(&mut Vec<u8>)>(&self, f: F) {\n        f(&mut self.inner.borrow_mut().data);\n    }\n    pub fn with_super<F: FnOnce(&mut Vec<u8>)>(&self, f: F) {\n        f(&mut self.inner.borrow_mut().superfile);\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一次“挂载”：持有独立的易失缓存、操作计数与故障规则。\npub struct SimStorage {\n    disk: Rc<RefCell<SimDiskState>>,\n    rules: RefCell<Vec<(FaultRule, bool)>>,\n    counts: RefCell<HashMap<(Target, Op), u64>>,\n    data_cache: RefCell<Vec<u8>>,\n    super_cache: RefCell<Option<(usize, Vec<u8>)>>,\n}\n\n/// 故障被触发时返回的 io::Error 内部错误，存储引擎据此与真实 I/O 错误区分。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct SimFaultError {\n    pub target: Target,\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub nth: u64,\n    pub kind: FaultKind,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for SimFaultError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"注入故障: {:?} 第 {} 个 {:?} -> {:?}\", self.target, self.nth, self.op, self.kind)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for SimFaultError {}\n\nimpl SimStorage {\n    /// 计数并检查本操作是否命中故障规则；命中则返回故障类型。\n    fn fire(&self, target: Target, op: Op) -> Option<FaultKind> {\n        let nth = {\n            let mut counts = self.counts.borrow_mut();\n            let e = counts.entry((target, op)).or_insert(0);\n            *e += 1;\n            *e\n        };\n        let mut rules = self.rules.borrow_mut();\n        for (rule, consumed) in rules.iter_mut() {\n            if !*consumed && rule.target == target && rule.op == op && rule.nth == nth {\n                *consumed = true;\n                return Some(rule.kind);\n            }\n        }\n        None\n    }\n\n    fn fault_err(&self, target: Target, op: Op, nth: u64, kind: FaultKind) -> io::Error {\n        io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, SimFaultError { target, op, nth, kind })\n    }\n\n    /// 断电：丢弃该挂载的全部易失缓存。\n    fn power_loss(&self) {\n        self.data_cache.borrow_mut().clear();\n        *self.super_cache.borrow_mut() = None;\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Storage for SimStorage {\n    fn read_data(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        Ok(self.disk.borrow().data.clone())\n    }\n\n    fn read_super(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        Ok(self.disk.borrow().superfile.clone())\n    }\n\n    fn append_data(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Data, Op::Write)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Data, Op::Write) {\n            match kind {\n                FaultKind::CrashBefore => {\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Data, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n                FaultKind::TearWrite(keep) => {\n                    // 掉电瞬间：本次追加只有前 keep 字节落盘，缓存全丢。\n                    let keep = keep.min(bytes.len());\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    let mut d = self.disk.borrow_mut();\n                    d.data.extend_from_slice(&bytes[..keep]);\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Data, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        self.data_cache.borrow_mut().extend_from_slice(bytes);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_data(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Data, Op::Sync)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Data, Op::Sync) {\n            self.power_loss();\n            return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Data, Op::Sync, nth, kind));\n        }\n        let pending = std::mem::take(&mut *self.data_cache.borrow_mut());\n        self.disk.borrow_mut().data.extend_from_slice(&pending);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_super_slot(&self, slot: usize, page: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        assert_eq!(page.len(), PAGE_SIZE, \"超级块写入必须恰好一页\");\n        assert!(slot < 2);\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Super, Op::Write)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Super, Op::Write) {\n            match kind {\n                FaultKind::CrashBefore => {\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Super, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n                FaultKind::TearWrite(keep) => {\n                    // 新页只落盘前 keep 字节（落在交替槽位，旧槽位不受影响）。\n                    let keep = keep.min(page.len());\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    let mut d = self.disk.borrow_mut();\n                    let pos = slot * PAGE_SIZE;\n                    d.superfile[pos..pos + keep].copy_from_slice(&page[..keep]);\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Super, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        self.super_cache.replace(Some((slot, page.to_vec())));\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_super(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Super, Op::Sync)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Super, Op::Sync) {\n            self.power_loss();\n            return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Super, Op::Sync, nth, kind));\n        }\n        if let Some((slot, page)) = self.super_cache.borrow_mut().take() {\n            let pos = slot * PAGE_SIZE;\n            let mut d = self.disk.borrow_mut();\n            d.superfile[pos..pos + PAGE_SIZE].copy_from_slice(&page);\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================ 真实文件后端 ============================\n\n/// 真实文件系统后端：数据文件以 O_APPEND 打开，超级块文件随机定位整页写。\npub struct RealStorage {\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    data: RefCell<File>,\n    superfile: RefCell<File>,\n}\n\nimpl RealStorage {\n    /// 在目录上挂载。要求目录与两个文件都已存在（先用 `format` 格式化）。\n    pub fn open(dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let data_path = dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE);\n        let super_path = dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE);\n        if !data_path.exists() || !super_path.exists() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"存储尚未格式化（缺少 data.log / super.db）\"));\n        }\n        let data = OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(&data_path)?;\n        let superfile = OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(&super_path)?;\n        Ok(RealStorage { dir: dir.to_path_buf(), data: RefCell::new(data), superfile: RefCell::new(superfile) })\n    }\n\n    /// 格式化：（重）建两个文件。数据文件截断为空；超级块文件先零填两页，\n    /// 随后由存储引擎把代次 0 的空超级块写入槽位 0。\n    pub fn create_files(dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;\n        let data = OpenOptions::new()\n            .create(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE))?;\n        data.sync_all()?;\n        let sf = OpenOptions::new()\n            .create(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE))?;\n        sf.set_len(SUPER_FILE_SIZE as u64)?;\n        sf.sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn dir(&self) -> &Path {\n        &self.dir\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Storage for RealStorage {\n    fn read_data(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let mut f = File::open(self.dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE))?;\n        let mut v = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut v)?;\n        Ok(v)\n    }\n\n    fn read_super(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let mut f = File::open(self.dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE))?;\n        let mut v = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut v)?;\n        Ok(v)\n    }\n\n    fn append_data(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.data.borrow_mut().write_all(bytes)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_data(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.data.borrow().sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn write_super_slot(&self, slot: usize, page: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        assert_eq!(page.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let mut f = self.superfile.borrow_mut();\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start((slot * PAGE_SIZE) as u64))?;\n        f.write_all(page)?;\n        // 复位到末尾不是必须的：超级块从不追加。\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_super(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.superfile.borrow().sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    /// 未同步的写在“断电”后必须全部丢失；sync 后的必须保留。\n    #[test]\n    fn crash_loses_only_unsynced_bytes() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        {\n            let s = disk.storage(vec![]);\n            s.append_data(b\"aaa\").unwrap();\n            s.sync_data().unwrap();\n            s.append_data(b\"bbb\").unwrap();\n            // 不 sync 直接丢弃挂载实例。\n        }\n        let s2 = disk.storage(vec![]);\n        assert_eq!(s2.read_data().unwrap(), b\"aaa\");\n    }\n\n    /// 半页写：只有前 keep 字节落盘。\n    #[test]\n    fn tear_write_persists_prefix_only() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        let rule = FaultRule::tear(Target::Data, 1, 2);\n        let s = disk.storage(vec![rule]);\n        let err = s.append_data(b\"abcdef\").unwrap_err();\n        assert!(err.get_ref().unwrap().is::<SimFaultError>());\n        assert_eq!(disk.stable_data(), b\"ab\");\n    }\n\n    /// 断电于 fsync 之前：整次提交的数据都不落盘。\n    #[test]\n    fn crash_before_sync_loses_whole_batch() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        let s = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Sync, 1)]);\n        s.append_data(b\"xyz\").unwrap();\n        assert!(s.sync_data().is_err());\n        assert!(disk.stable_data().is_empty());\n    }\n}\n","file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a/src/io_layer.rs"}},"apiBlockIndex":2,"type":"assistant","uuid":"cabc725c-f11a-46a0-9151-b3973f19167f","timestamp":"2026-09-23T01:36:48.312Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"aa155883-6d0d-48f5-bfbf-9f0daaa5a572","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a","sessionId":"aa155883-6d0d-48f5-bfbf-9f0daaa5a572","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp1-a","slug":"tender-tinkering-wave"}

FaultRule {\n    pub fn crash(target: Target, op: Op, nth: u64) -> Self {\n        FaultRule { target, op, nth, kind: FaultKind::CrashBefore }\n    }\n    pub fn tear(target: Target, nth: u64, keep: usize) -> Self {\n        FaultRule { target, op: Op::Write, nth, kind: FaultKind::TearWrite(keep) }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 存储引擎依赖的 I/O 原语。一次提交中的调用顺序见模块级文档。\npub trait Storage {\n    /// 读取数据文件全部字节（挂载时使用）。\n    fn read_data(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    /// 读取超级块文件全部字节（挂载时使用）。\n    fn read_super(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    /// 向数据文件末尾追加一次逻辑写入。\n    fn append_data(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// fsync 数据文件。\n    fn sync_data(&self) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 将整页（PAGE_SIZE）写入超级块指定槽位。\n    fn write_super_slot(&self, slot: usize, page: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// fsync 超级块文件。\n    fn sync_super(&self) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\n/// 模拟磁盘的稳定状态（可被多个“挂载实例”共享，模拟重挂载）。\nstruct SimDiskState {\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n    superfile: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 进程内模拟磁盘句柄。克隆廉价（内部引用计数）。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct SimDisk {\n    inner: Rc<RefCell<SimDiskState>>,\n}\n\nimpl SimDisk {\n    /// 新建一块“已分区但未格式化”的空盘：数据文件为空，超级块文件为\n    /// SUPER_FILE_SIZE 个零字节（零页对恢复而言是无效页）。\n    pub fn fresh() -> Self {\n        SimDisk {\n            inner: Rc::new(RefCell::new(SimDiskState {\n                data: Vec::new(),\n                superfile: vec![0u8; SUPER_FILE_SIZE],\n            })),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 用给定故障规则重新挂载（旧挂载的缓存天然不可见）。\n    pub fn storage(&self, rules: Vec<FaultRule>) -> SimStorage {\n        for r in &rules {\n            if matches!(r.kind, FaultKind::TearWrite(_)) && r.op != Op::Write {\n                panic!(\"TearWrite 只能注入写操作，规则: {r:?}\");\n            }\n        }\n        SimStorage {\n            disk: self.inner.clone(),\n            rules: RefCell::new(rules.into_iter().map(|r| (r, false)).collect()),\n            counts: RefCell::new(HashMap::new()),\n            data_cache: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),\n            super_cache: RefCell::new(None),\n        }\n    }\n\n    // —— 供测试直接篡改稳定存储（模拟盘外介质损坏 / 人工造数）——\n\n    pub fn stable_data(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        self.inner.borrow().data.clone()\n    }\n    pub fn stable_super(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        self.inner.borrow().superfile.clone()\n    }\n    pub fn set_stable_data(&self, data: Vec<u8>) {\n        self.inner.borrow_mut().data = data;\n    }\n    pub fn set_stable_super(&self, superfile: Vec<u8>) {\n        assert_eq!(superfile.len(), SUPER_FILE_SIZE);\n        self.inner.borrow_mut().superfile = superfile;\n    }\n    /// 就地修改稳定存储字节。\n    pub fn with_data<F: FnOnce(&mut Vec<u8>)>(&self, f: F) {\n        f(&mut self.inner.borrow_mut().data);\n    }\n    pub fn with_super<F: FnOnce(&mut Vec<u8>)>(&self, f: F) {\n        f(&mut self.inner.borrow_mut().superfile);\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一次“挂载”：持有独立的易失缓存、操作计数与故障规则。\npub struct SimStorage {\n    disk: Rc<RefCell<SimDiskState>>,\n    rules: RefCell<Vec<(FaultRule, bool)>>,\n    counts: RefCell<HashMap<(Target, Op), u64>>,\n    data_cache: RefCell<Vec<u8>>,\n    super_cache: RefCell<Option<(usize, Vec<u8>)>>,\n}\n\n/// 故障被触发时返回的 io::Error 内部错误，存储引擎据此与真实 I/O 错误区分。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct SimFaultError {\n    pub target: Target,\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub nth: u64,\n    pub kind: FaultKind,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for SimFaultError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"注入故障: {:?} 第 {} 个 {:?} -> {:?}\", self.target, self.nth, self.op, self.kind)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for SimFaultError {}\n\nimpl SimStorage {\n    /// 计数并检查本操作是否命中故障规则；命中则返回故障类型。\n    fn fire(&self, target: Target, op: Op) -> Option<FaultKind> {\n        let nth = {\n            let mut counts = self.counts.borrow_mut();\n            let e = counts.entry((target, op)).or_insert(0);\n            *e += 1;\n            *e\n        };\n        let mut rules = self.rules.borrow_mut();\n        for (rule, consumed) in rules.iter_mut() {\n            if !*consumed && rule.target == target && rule.op == op && rule.nth == nth {\n                *consumed = true;\n                return Some(rule.kind);\n            }\n        }\n        None\n    }\n\n    fn fault_err(&self, target: Target, op: Op, nth: u64, kind: FaultKind) -> io::Error {\n        io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, SimFaultError { target, op, nth, kind })\n    }\n\n    /// 断电：丢弃该挂载的全部易失缓存。\n    fn power_loss(&self) {\n        self.data_cache.borrow_mut().clear();\n        *self.super_cache.borrow_mut() = None;\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Storage for SimStorage {\n    fn read_data(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        Ok(self.disk.borrow().data.clone())\n    }\n\n    fn read_super(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        Ok(self.disk.borrow().superfile.clone())\n    }\n\n    fn append_data(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Data, Op::Write)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Data, Op::Write) {\n            match kind {\n                FaultKind::CrashBefore => {\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Data, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n                FaultKind::TearWrite(keep) => {\n                    // 掉电瞬间：本次追加只有前 keep 字节落盘，缓存全丢。\n                    let keep = keep.min(bytes.len());\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    let mut d = self.disk.borrow_mut();\n                    d.data.extend_from_slice(&bytes[..keep]);\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Data, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        self.data_cache.borrow_mut().extend_from_slice(bytes);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_data(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Data, Op::Sync)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Data, Op::Sync) {\n            self.power_loss();\n            return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Data, Op::Sync, nth, kind));\n        }\n        let pending = std::mem::take(&mut *self.data_cache.borrow_mut());\n        self.disk.borrow_mut().data.extend_from_slice(&pending);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_super_slot(&self, slot: usize, page: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        assert_eq!(page.len(), PAGE_SIZE, \"超级块写入必须恰好一页\");\n        assert!(slot < 2);\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Super, Op::Write)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Super, Op::Write) {\n            match kind {\n                FaultKind::CrashBefore => {\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Super, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n                FaultKind::TearWrite(keep) => {\n                    // 新页只落盘前 keep 字节（落在交替槽位，旧槽位不受影响）。\n                    let keep = keep.min(page.len());\n                    self.power_loss();\n                    let mut d = self.disk.borrow_mut();\n                    let pos = slot * PAGE_SIZE;\n                    d.superfile[pos..pos + keep].copy_from_slice(&page[..keep]);\n                    return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Super, Op::Write, nth, kind));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        self.super_cache.replace(Some((slot, page.to_vec())));\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_super(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = *self.counts.borrow().get(&(Target::Super, Op::Sync)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;\n        if let Some(kind) = self.fire(Target::Super, Op::Sync) {\n            self.power_loss();\n            return Err(self.fault_err(Target::Super, Op::Sync, nth, kind));\n        }\n        if let Some((slot, page)) = self.super_cache.borrow_mut().take() {\n            let pos = slot * PAGE_SIZE;\n            let mut d = self.disk.borrow_mut();\n            d.superfile[pos..pos + PAGE_SIZE].copy_from_slice(&page);\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================ 真实文件后端 ============================\n\n/// 真实文件系统后端：数据文件以 O_APPEND 打开，超级块文件随机定位整页写。\npub struct RealStorage {\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    data: RefCell<File>,\n    superfile: RefCell<File>,\n}\n\nimpl RealStorage {\n    /// 在目录上挂载。要求目录与两个文件都已存在（先用 `format` 格式化）。\n    pub fn open(dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let data_path = dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE);\n        let super_path = dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE);\n        if !data_path.exists() || !super_path.exists() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"存储尚未格式化（缺少 data.log / super.db）\"));\n        }\n        let data = OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(&data_path)?;\n        let superfile = OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(&super_path)?;\n        Ok(RealStorage { dir: dir.to_path_buf(), data: RefCell::new(data), superfile: RefCell::new(superfile) })\n    }\n\n    /// 格式化：（重）建两个文件。数据文件截断为空；超级块文件先零填两页，\n    /// 随后由存储引擎把代次 0 的空超级块写入槽位 0。\n    pub fn create_files(dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;\n        let data = OpenOptions::new()\n            .create(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE))?;\n        data.sync_all()?;\n        let sf = OpenOptions::new()\n            .create(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE))?;\n        sf.set_len(SUPER_FILE_SIZE as u64)?;\n        sf.sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn dir(&self) -> &Path {\n        &self.dir\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Storage for RealStorage {\n    fn read_data(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let mut f = File::open(self.dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE))?;\n        let mut v = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut v)?;\n        Ok(v)\n    }\n\n    fn read_super(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let mut f = File::open(self.dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE))?;\n        let mut v = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut v)?;\n        Ok(v)\n    }\n\n    fn append_data(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.data.borrow_mut().write_all(bytes)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_data(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.data.borrow().sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn write_super_slot(&self, slot: usize, page: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        assert_eq!(page.len(), PAGE_SIZE);\n        let mut f = self.superfile.borrow_mut();\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start((slot * PAGE_SIZE) as u64))?;\n        f.write_all(page)?;\n        // 复位到末尾不是必须的：超级块从不追加。\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_super(&self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.superfile.borrow().sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    /// 未同步的写在“断电”后必须全部丢失；sync 后的必须保留。\n    #[test]\n    fn crash_loses_only_unsynced_bytes() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        {\n            let s = disk.storage(vec![]);\n            s.append_data(b\"aaa\").unwrap();\n            s.sync_data().unwrap();\n            s.append_data(b\"bbb\").unwrap();\n            // 不 sync 直接丢弃挂载实例。\n        }\n        let s2 = disk.storage(vec![]);\n        assert_eq!(s2.read_data().unwrap(), b\"aaa\");\n    }\n\n    /// 半页写：只有前 keep 字节落盘。\n    #[test]\n    fn tear_write_persists_prefix_only() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        let rule = FaultRule::tear(Target::Data, 1, 2);\n        let s = disk.storage(vec![rule]);\n        let err = s.append_data(b\"abcdef\").unwrap_err();\n        assert!(err.get_ref().unwrap().is::<SimFaultError>());\n        assert_eq!(disk.stable_data(), b\"ab\");\n    }\n\n    /// 断电于 fsync 之前：整次提交的数据都不落盘。\n    #[test]\n    fn crash_before_sync_loses_whole_batch() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        let s = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Sync, 1)]);\n        s.append_data(b\"xyz\").unwrap();\n        assert!(s.sync_data().is_err());\n        assert!(disk.stable_data().is_empty());\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"cabc725c-f11a-46a0-9151-b3973f19167f","session_id":"aa155883-6d0d-48f5-bfbf-9f0daaa5a572","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a","sessionId":"aa155883-6d0d-48f5-bfbf-9f0daaa5a572","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp1-a","slug":"tender-tinkering-wave"}

{"parentUuid":"96b3e1a3-d8d0-44cc-aaf6-2708ce417041","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_rt9bmfbx1ty8z1pc5zhxxiqg","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a/src/store.rs","content":"//! 存储引擎：append-only 数据文件 + 交替双页超级块。\n//!\n//! 这一层完全通过 [`Storage`] 抽象访问介质，因此同一套引擎代码既能跑在\n//! 真实文件上，也能跑在可注入断电/半页写的模拟磁盘上。\n//!\n//! ## 写入（提交协议，同步边界见 `format` 模块文档）\n//!\n//! 1. 为当前快照中的每个键写一条 LEAF 记录，fsync 数据文件；\n//! 2. 写 ROOT 快照记录，fsync 数据文件（**先同步数据，再发布根**）；\n//! 3. 在交替槽位整页写新超级块，fsync 超级块文件。\n//!\n//! 内存状态只在第 3 步成功后才更新，因此故障后旧仓库镜像仍然自洽。\n//!\n//! ## 恢复\n//!\n//! 挂载时两槽位各做解码，并从**最高代次**开始验证候选：\n//! 根指针越界、记录 CRC 不符、ROOT 代次不一致、任一 LEAF 引用越界/损坏，\n//! 该候选即失效，转而去验证较旧代次；两个槽位都失效才报错（绝不静默使用\n//! 无效指针）。这就是“选取完整且引用有效的最高代次，拒绝越界指针”。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::fmt;\nuse std::io;\n\nuse crate::format::{\n    decode_leaf, decode_root, decode_super_page, encode_leaf, encode_record, encode_root,\n    encode_super_page, get_u32, slot_for_generation, Kind, Ptr, Record, Root, RootEntry,\n    SuperBlock, SUPER_FILE_SIZE, SUPER_SLOTS,\n};\nuse crate::io_layer::{SimFaultError, Storage};\n\n/// 键/值长度上限（防止损坏数据中的长度字段造成巨量分配）。\nconst MAX_KV_LEN: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StoreError {\n    /// I/O 错误（真实文件错误，或测试注入的断电/半页写故障）。\n    Io(io::Error),\n    /// 目录下没有可识别的存储文件。\n    NotFormatted,\n    /// 两个超级块槽位都无效，或所有候选根均引用失败。\n    CorruptStore(String),\n    /// 键/值超长。\n    TooLarge { what: &'static str, len: usize },\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for StoreError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            StoreError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"I/O 错误: {e}\"),\n            StoreError::NotFormatted => write!(f, \"存储尚未格式化\"),\n            StoreError::CorruptStore(s) => write!(f, \"存储不可恢复: {s}\"),\n            StoreError::TooLarge { what, len } => write!(f, \"{what} 过长: {len} 字节\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for StoreError {\n    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {\n        match self {\n            StoreError::Io(e) => Some(e),\n            _ => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl From<io::Error> for StoreError {\n {"parentUuid":"75880831-1191-4455-81f2-01fef7e98fdd","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_25i3zryrb1okvnofrxsmtz5s","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a/src/selftest.rs","content":"//! 崩溃恢复自检：在模拟磁盘上穷举一次提交的全部故障点，并构造\n//! 半页写、双根损坏、旧根回退、越界指针等验收场景。\n//!\n//! `cargo test` 会逐条断言这些场景；HTTP `/admin/selftest` 与\n//! `dual-superblock selftest` 复用 [`run`] 返回人类可读报告。\n\nuse crate::format::{\n    decode_super_page, encode_super_page, get_u64, put_u32, put_u64, slot_for_generation,\n    SuperBlock, PAGE_SIZE,\n};\nuse crate::io_layer::{FaultKind, FaultRule, Op, SimDisk, Storage, Target};\nuse crate::store::{Repository, StoreError};\nuse crate::crc::Crc32;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct CaseResult {\n    pub name: String,\n    pub passed: bool,\n    pub detail: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Report {\n    pub cases: Vec<CaseResult>,\n}\n\nimpl Report {\n    pub fn all_passed(&self) -> bool {\n        self.cases.iter().all(|c| c.passed)\n    }\n    pub fn render_text(&self) -> String {\n        let mut out = String::new();\n        for c in &self.cases {\n            let mark = if c.passed { \"PASS\" } else { \"FAIL\" };\n            out.push_str(&format!(\"[{mark}] {}\\n        {}\\n\", c.name, c.detail));\n        }\n        out.push_str(&format!(\n            \"\\n共 {} 项，通过 {}，失败 {}\\n\",\n            self.cases.len(),\n            self.cases.iter().filter(|c| c.passed).count(),\n            self.cases.iter().filter(|c| !c.passed).count()\n        ));\n        out\n    }\n}\n\nfn case(name: &str, f: impl FnOnce() -> Result<String, String>) -> CaseResult {\n    match f() {\n        Ok(detail) => CaseResult { name: name.into(), passed: true, detail },\n        Err(detail) => CaseResult { name: name.into(), passed: false, detail },\n    }\n}\n\nfn expect_injected(e: &StoreError) -> Result<(), String> {\n    if e.is_injected_fault() {\n        Ok(())\n    } else {\n        Err(format!(\"应返回注入故障，实际为: {e}\"))\n    }\n}\n\n/// 格式化并做 `n` 次干净提交（每次写一个键 g1..gn）。\nfn build(disk: &SimDisk, n: u64) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut repo = Repository::format(disk.storage(vec![]))\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"format 失败: {e}\"))?;\n    for g in 1..=n {\n        let key = format!(\"g{g}\");\n        repo.put_batch([(key.as_bytes(), vec![g as u8; 8].as_slice())])\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"提交代次 {g} 失败: {e}\"))?;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 用给定故障规则重新挂载并尝试一次单键提交；用完即“断电丢弃”该实例。\nfn attempt_commit(\n    disk: &SimDisk,\n    rules: Vec<FaultRule>,\n    key: &[u8],\n    val: &[u8],\n) -> Result<u64, StoreError> {\n    let mut repo = Repository::open(disk.storage(rules))?;\n    let snap = repo.put_batch([(key, val)])?;\n    Ok(snap.generation)\n}\n\nfn reopened_generation(disk: &SimDisk) -> Result<u64, String> {\n    let repo = Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![])).map_err(|e| format!(\"重新挂载失败: {e}\"))?;\n    Ok(repo.generation())\n}\n\n/// 运行全部自检用例。\npub fn run() -> Report {\n    let mut cases = Vec::new();\n\n    // ---- 1. 干净路径：5 代次，槽位严格交替，逐代可读 ----\n    cases.push(case(\"干净提交×5：双槽交替且全部键可读\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 5)?;\n        let repo = Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![]))\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"重挂载失败: {e}\"))?;\n        if repo.generation() != 5 {\n            return Err(format!(\"期望代次 5，实际 {}\", repo.generation()));\n        }\n        for g in 1..=5u64 {\n            let key = format!(\"g{g}\");\n            match repo.get(key.as_bytes()) {\n                Some(v) if v == vec![g as u8; 8] => {}\n                other => return Err(format!(\"键 {key} 内容错误: {other:?}\")),\n            }\n        }\n        // 两个槽位应分别解码为代次 5（槽1）与 4（槽0）。\n        let sf = disk.stable_super();\n        let s0 = decode_super_page(&sf[0..PAGE_SIZE]).unwrap();\n        let s1 = decode_super_page(&sf[PAGE_SIZE..2 * PAGE_SIZE]).unwrap();\n        if s0.generation != 4 || s1.generation != 5 {\n            return Err(format!(\"槽位代次错误: 槽0={} 槽1={}\", s0.generation, s1.generation));\n        }\n        Ok(\"代次5已发布；槽0=代次4、槽1=代次5，符合交替规则\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 2. 崩溃点穷举：代次3→4 的一次提交，6 个注入点逐一崩溃 ----\n    // 单键提交的操作序号：\n    //   数据写: 1=LEAF, 2=ROOT；数据 sync: 1=叶子后, 2=根后；\n    //   超级块写: 1；超级块 sync: 1。\n    let crash_points: [(&str, Target, Op, u64); 6] = [\n        (\"写 LEAF 前\", Target::Data, Op::Write, 1),\n        (\"LEAF 后 fsync 前\", Target::Data, Op::Sync, 1),\n        (\"写 ROOT 前\", Target::Data, Op::Write, 2),\n        (\"ROOT 后 fsync 前\", Target::Data, Op::Sync, 2),\n        (\"写超级块页前\", Target::Super, Op::Write, 1),\n        (\"超级块 fsync 前\", Target::Super, Op::Sync, 1),\n    ];\n    for (label, target, op, nth) in crash_points {\n        let label = label.to_string();\n        cases.push(case(\n            &format!(\"崩溃于「{label}」：恢复到上一完整代次3\"),\n            move || {\n                let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n                build(&disk, 3)?;\n                let err = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::crash(target, op, nth)], b\"g4\", &[4; 8])\n                    .map_err(|e| e)\n                    .and_then(|_| Err::<(), StoreError>(unreachable_hack()))\n                    .err()\n                    .ok_or_else(|| \"注入崩溃后提交应失败\".to_string())?;\n                expect_injected(&err)?;\n                let g = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n                if g != 3 {\n                    return Err(format!(\"应回退到代次3，实际代次 {g}\"));\n                }\n                let repo = Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![])).unwrap();\n                if repo.get(b\"g4\").is_some() {\n                    return Err(\"未提交成功的键 g4 不应可见\".into());\n                }\n                if repo.get(b\"g3\") != Some([3u8; 8].as_slice()) {\n                    return Err(\"代次3 的数据应完好\".into());\n                }\n                Ok(\"新代次未发布，代次3完整可读\".into())\n            },\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // ---- 3a. 半页写：超级块新页只落盘 8 字节（头部被截断）----\n    cases.push(case(\"半页写-超级块(保留8B)：新页头损坏，旧槽位接管\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 3)?;\n        let err = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Super, 1, 8)], b\"g4\", &[4; 8])\n            .err()\n            .ok_or_else(|| \"应返回半页写故障\".to_string())?;\n        expect_injected(&err)?;\n        let g = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n        if g != 3 {\n            return Err(format!(\"应回退代次3，实际 {g}\"));\n        }\n        Ok(\"交替槽位的旧超级块(代次3) CRC 完好，恢复成功\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 3b. 半页写：超级块新页落盘 2048 字节（头在但整页 CRC 不可能通过）----\n    cases.push(case(\"半页写-超级块(保留2048B)：页头CRC失败，拒绝半新页\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 3)?;\n        let err = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Super, 1, 2048)], b\"g4\", &[4; 8])\n            .err()\n            .ok_or_else(|| \"应返回半页写故障\".to_string())?;\n        expect_injected(&err)?;\n        let g = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n        if g != 3 {\n            return Err(format!(\"应回退代次3，实际 {g}\"));\n        }\n        Ok(\"半新页 header_crc 校验失败，被明确拒绝\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 3c. 半页写恰好整页：等价成功 ----\n    cases.push(case(\"超级块写入保留4096B(整页)：代次4正常发布\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 3)?;\n        let g = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Super, 1, PAGE_SIZE)], b\"g4\", &[4; 8])\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"整页写入应成功: {e}\"))?;\n        if g != 4 {\n            return Err(format!(\"期望代次4，实际 {g}\"));\n        }\n        let g2 = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n        if g2 != 4 {\n            return Err(format!(\"重挂载后期望4，实际 {g2}\"));\n        }\n        Ok(\"整页原子落盘，恢复为代次4\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 3d. 半页写：LEAF 记录只落盘一半（垃圾尾巴必须被容忍）----\n    cases.push(case(\"半页写-LEAF(保留3B)：残缺叶子成为垃圾尾巴，根未发布\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 2)?;\n        let err = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Data, 1, 3)], b\"g3\", &[3; 8])\n            .err()\n            .ok_or_else(|| \"应返回半页写故障\".to_string())?;\n        expect_injected(&err)?;\n        let g = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n        if g != 2 {\n            return Err(format!(\"应回退代次2，实际 {g}\"));\n        }\n        let data_len = disk.stable_data().len() as u64;\n        // 残留的 3 字节垃圾不应影响打开。\n        if data_len < 3 {\n            return Err(\"半页前缀应已落盘\".into());\n        }\n        Ok(\"数据文件含3字节残缺尾巴，扫描在损坏处停止，恢复代次2\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 3e. 半页写：ROOT 记录只落盘一半 ----\n    cases.push(case(\"半页写-ROOT(保留5B)：根半成品被忽略\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 2)?;\n        let err = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Data, 2, 5)], b\"g3\", &[3; 8])\n            .err()\n            .ok_or_else(|| \"应返回半页写故障\".to_string())?;\n        expect_injected(&err)?;\n        let g = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n        if g != 2 {\n            return Err(format!(\"应回退代次2，实际 {g}\"));\n        }\n        Ok(\"叶子已落盘但无超级块指向；ROOT 半成品 CRC 不符，恢复代次2\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 4. 两个超级块均损坏 ----\n format!(\"format 失败: {e}\"))?;\n    for g in 1..=n {\n        let key = format!(\"g{g}\");\n        repo.put_batch([(key.as_bytes(), vec![g as u8; 8].as_slice())])\n            .map_err(|e| 崩溃恢复自检：在模拟磁盘上穷举一次提交的全部故障点，并构造\n//! 半页写、双根损坏、旧根回退、越界指针等验收场景。\n//!\n//! `cargo test` 会逐条断言这些场景；HTTP `/admin/selftest` 与\n//! `dual-superblock selftest` 复用 [`run`] 返回人类可读报告。\n\nuse crate::format::{\n    decode_super_page, encode_super_page, get_u64, put_u32, put_u64, slot_for_generation,\n    SuperBlock, PAGE_SIZE,\n};\nuse crate::io_layer::{FaultKind, FaultRule, Op, SimDisk, Storage, Target};\nuse crate::store::{Repository, StoreError};\nuse crate::crc::Crc32;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct CaseResult {\n    pub name: String,\n    pub passed: bool,\n    pub detail: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Report {\n    pub cases: Vec<CaseResult>,\n}\n\nimpl Report {\n    pub fn all_passed(&self) -> bool {\n        self.cases.iter().all(|c| c.passed)\n    }\n    pub fn render_text(&self) -> String {\n        let mut out = String::new();\n        for c in &self.cases {\n            let mark = if c.passed { \"PASS\" } else { \"FAIL\" };\n            out.push_str(&format!(\"[{mark}] {}\\n        {}\\n\", c.name, c.detail));\n        }\n        out.push_str(&format!(\n            \"\\n共 {} 项，通过 {}，失败 {}\\n\",\n            self.cases.len(),\n            self.cases.iter().filter(|c| c.passed).count(),\n            self.cases.iter().filter(|c| !c.passed).count()\n        ));\n        out\n    }\n}\n\nfn case(name: &str, f: impl FnOnce() -> Result<String, String>) -> CaseResult {\n    match f() {\n        Ok(detail) => CaseResult { name: name.into(), passed: true, detail },\n        Err(detail) => CaseResult { name: name.into(), passed: false, detail },\n    }\n}\n\nfn expect_injected(e: &StoreError) -> Result<(), String> {\n    if e.is_injected_fault() {\n        Ok(())\n    } else {\n        Err(format!(\"应返回注入故障，实际为: {e}\"))\n    }\n}\n\n/// 格式化并做 `n` 次干净提交（每次写一个键 g1..gn）。\nfn build(disk: &SimDisk, n: u64) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut repo = Repository::format(disk.storage(vec![]))\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"format 失败: {e}\"))?;\n    for g in 1..=n {\n        let key = format!(\"g{g}\");\n        repo.put_batch([(key.as_bytes(), vec![g as u8; 8].as_slice())])\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"提交代次 {g} 失败: {e}\"))?;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 用给定故障规则重新挂载并尝试一次单键提交；用完即“断电丢弃”该实例。\nfn attempt_commit(\n    disk: &SimDisk,\n    rules: Vec<FaultRule>,\n    key: &[u8],\n    val: &[u8],\n) -> Result<u64, StoreError> {\n    let mut repo = Repository::open(disk.storage(rules))?;\n    let snap = repo.put_batch([(key, val)])?;\n    Ok(snap.generation)\n}\n\nfn reopened_generation(disk: &SimDisk) -> Result<u64, String> {\n    let repo = Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![])).map_err(|e| format!(\"重新挂载失败: {e}\"))?;\n    Ok(repo.generation())\n}\n\n/// 运行全部自检用例。\npub fn run() -> Report {\n    let mut cases = Vec::new();\n\n    // ---- 1. 干净路径：5 代次，槽位严格交替，逐代可读 ----\n    cases.push(case(\"干净提交×5：双槽交替且全部键可读\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 5)?;\n        let repo = Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![]))\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"重挂载失败: {e}\"))?;\n        if repo.generation() != 5 {\n            return Err(format!(\"期望代次 5，实际 {}\", repo.generation()));\n        }\n        for g in 1..=5u64 {\n            let key = format!(\"g{g}\");\n            match repo.get(key.as_bytes()) {\n                Some(v) if v == vec![g as u8; 8] => {}\n                other => return Err(format!(\"键 {key} 内容错误: {other:?}\")),\n            }\n        }\n        // 两个槽位应分别解码为代次 5（槽1）与 4（槽0）。\n        let sf = disk.stable_super();\n        let s0 = decode_super_page(&sf[0..PAGE_SIZE]).unwrap();\n        let s1 = decode_super_page(&sf[PAGE_SIZE..2 * PAGE_SIZE]).unwrap();\n        if s0.generation != 4 || s1.generation != 5 {\n            return Err(format!(\"槽位代次错误: 槽0={} 槽1={}\", s0.generation, s1.generation));\n        }\n        Ok(\"代次5已发布；槽0=代次4、槽1=代次5，符合交替规则\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 2. 崩溃点穷举：代次3→4 的一次提交，6 个注入点逐一崩溃 ----\n    // 单键提交的操作序号：\n    //   数据写: 1=LEAF, 2=ROOT；数据 sync: 1=叶子后, 2=根后；\n    //   超级块写: 1；超级块 sync: 1。\n    let crash_points: [(&str, Target, Op, u64); 6] = [\n        (\"写 LEAF 前\", Target::Data, Op::Write, 1),\n        (\"LEAF 后 fsync 前\", Target::Data, Op::Sync, 1),\n        (\"写 ROOT 前\", Target::Data, Op::Write, 2),\n        (\"ROOT 后 fsync 前\", Target::Data, Op::Sync, 2),\n        (\"写超级块页前\", Target::Super, Op::Write, 1),\n        (\"超级块 fsync 前\", Target::Super, Op::Sync, 1),\n    ];\n    for (label, target, op, nth) in crash_points {\n        let label = label.to_string();\n        cases.push(case(\n            &format!(\"崩溃于「{label}」：恢复到上一完整代次3\"),\n            move || {\n                let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n                build(&disk, 3)?;\n                let err = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::crash(target, op, nth)], b\"g4\", &[4; 8])\n                    .map_err(|e| e)\n                    .and_then(|_| Err::<(), StoreError>(unreachable_hack()))\n                    .err()\n                    .ok_or_else(|| \"注入崩溃后提交应失败\".to_string())?;\n                expect_injected(&err)?;\n                let g = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n                if g != 3 {\n                    return Err(format!(\"应回退到代次3，实际代次 {g}\"));\n                }\n                let repo = Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![])).unwrap();\n                if repo.get(b\"g4\").is_some() {\n                    return Err(\"未提交成功的键 g4 不应可见\".into());\n                }\n                if repo.get(b\"g3\") != Some([3u8; 8].as_slice()) {\n                    return Err(\"代次3 的数据应完好\".into());\n                }\n                Ok(\"新代次未发布，代次3完整可读\".into())\n            },\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // ---- 3a. 半页写：超级块新页只落盘 8 字节（头部被截断）----\n    cases.push(case(\"半页写-超级块(保留8B)：新页头损坏，旧槽位接管\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 3)?;\n        let err = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Super, 1, 8)], b\"g4\", &[4; 8])\n            .err()\n            .ok_or_else(|| \"应返回半页写故障\".to_string())?;\n        expect_injected(&err)?;\n 3b. 半页写：超级块新页落盘 2048 字节（头在但整页 CRC 不可能通过）----\n    cases.push(case(\"半页写-超级块(保留2048B)：页头CRC失败，拒绝半新页\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 3)?;\n        let err = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Super, 1, 2048)], b\"g4\", &[4; 8])\n            .err()\n            .ok_or_else(|| \"应返回半页写故障\".to_string())?;\n        expect_injected(&err)?;\n        let g = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n        if g != 3 {\n            return Err(format!(\"应回退代次3，实际 {g}\"));\n        }\n        Ok(\"半新页 header_crc 校验失败，被明确拒绝\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 3c. 半页写恰好整页：等价成功 ----\n    cases.push(case(\"超级块写入保留4096B(整页)：代次4正常发布\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 3)?;\n        let g = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Super, 1, PAGE_SIZE)], b\"g4\", &[4; 8])\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"整页写入应成功: {e}\"))?;\n        if g != 4 {\n            return Err(format!(\"期望代次4，实际 {g}\"));\n        }\n        let g2 = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n        if g2 != 4 {\n            return Err(format!(\"重挂载后期望4，实际 {g2}\"));\n        }\n        Ok(\"整页原子落盘，恢复为代次4\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 3d. 半页写：LEAF 记录只落盘一半（垃圾尾巴必须被容忍）----\n    cases.push(case(\"半页写-LEAF(保留3B)：残缺叶子成为垃圾尾巴，根未发布\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 2)?;\n        let err = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Data, 1, 3)], b\"g3\", &[3; 8])\n            .err()\n            .ok_or_else(|| \"应返回半页写故障\".to_string())?;\n        expect_injected(&err)?;\n        let g = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n        if g != 2 {\n            return Err(format!(\"应回退代次2，实际 {g}\"));\n        }\n        let data_len = disk.stable_data().len() as u64;\n        // 残留的 3 字节垃圾不应影响打开。\n        if data_len < 3 {\n            return Err(\"半页前缀应已落盘\".into());\n        }\n        Ok(\"数据文件含3字节残缺尾巴，扫描在损坏处停止，恢复代次2\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 3e. 半页写：ROOT 记录只落盘一半 ----\n    cases.push(case(\"半页写-ROOT(保留5B)：根半成品被忽略\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 2)?;\n        let err = attempt_commit(&disk, vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Data, 2, 5)], b\"g3\", &[3; 8])\n            .err()\n            .ok_or_else(|| \"应返回半页写故障\".to_string())?;\n        expect_injected(&err)?;\n        let g = reopened_generation(&disk)?;\n        if g != 2 {\n            return Err(format!(\"应回退代次2，实际 {g}\"));\n        }\n        Ok(\"叶子已落盘但无超级块指向；ROOT 半成品 CRC 不符，恢复代次2\".into())\n    }));\n\n    // ---- 4. 两个超级块均损坏 ----\n    cases.push(case(\"两个根槽位同时损坏：明确报错而非静默\", || {\n        let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n        build(&disk, 2)?;\n        // 把两页头部魔数都打坏。\n        disk.with_super(|sf| {\n            sf[0] ^= 0xFF;\n            sf[PAGE_SIZE] ^= 0xFF;\n        });\n        match Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![])) {\n            Err(StoreError::CorruptStore(msg)) => {\n                if !msg.contains(\"两个超级块槽位均无效\") {"parentUuid":"2777594e-9de6-4bae-a83a-4b9d63e90e47","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_uydk1uott59oez4y0rvoyacq","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a/src/http_server.rs","content":"//! 本地 HTTP 验证入口。\n//!\n//! 仅依赖标准库手写的最小 HTTP/1.1 服务，**单线程顺序处理**（本地验证足够，\n//! 且让提交协议的同步语义清晰可观察）。\n//!\n//! # 路由\n//!\n//! | 方法 路径 | 说明 |\n//! |---|---|\n//! | `GET  /health` | 存活检查 |\n//! | `POST /format` | 格式化目录（截断重建）|\n//! | `GET  /kv/<key>` | 读取单键，不存在返回 404 |\n//! | `PUT  /kv/<key>` | 写入单键（请求体原样作为值；可用 `-H 'X-Value-Base64: 1'` 传二进制）|\n//! | `DELETE /kv/<key>` | 删除单键 |\n//! | `PUT  /kv` | 批量写，body 为 JSON：`{\"items\":[{\"key\":\"...\",\"value\":\"...\"}]}` |\n//! | `GET  /kv` | 列出全部键值（JSON 数组）|\n//! | `GET  /snapshot` | 当前代次、根指针、条目数 |\n//! | `GET  /admin/selftest` | 在模拟磁盘上跑全部崩溃恢复自检并返回报告 |\n//!\n//! 键按路径原样解释（UTF-8 字节）；特殊字符请先百分号编码。\n//! 响应统一为 JSON（`GET /kv/<key>` 默认返回原始字节，加 `?format=json` 返回 JSON）。\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse crate::io_layer::RealStorage;\nuse crate::selftest;\nuse crate::store::Repository;\n\npub struct HttpConfig {\n    pub addr: String,\n    pub dir: String,\n}\n\n/// 启动服务（阻塞）。目录未格式化时自动 format。\npub fn serve(cfg: &HttpConfig) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let dir = Path::new(&cfg.dir);\n    let data_exists = dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE).exists();\n    let super_exists = dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE).exists();\n    if !data_exists || !super_exists {\n        RealStorage::create_files(dir)?;\n        let st = RealStorage::open(dir)?;\n        Repository::format(st).expect(\"新介质格式化不应失败\");\n        eprintln!(\"[init] 已在 {} 完成格式化\", cfg.dir);\n    }\n\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(&cfg.addr)?;\n    eprintln!(\"[serve] 监听 http://{} ，数据目录 {}\", cfg.addr, cfg.dir);\n    for stream in listener.incoming() {\n        match stream {\n            Ok(mut stream) => {\n                let _ = stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)));\n                let _ = stream.set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)));\n                if let Err(e) = handle_connection(&mut stream, dir) {\n                    eprintln!(\"[warn] 连接处理出错: {e}\");\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => eprintln!(\"[warn] accept 失败: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn handle_connection(stream: &mut TcpStream, dir: &Path) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let req = match read_request(stream) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => {\n            respond_text(stream, 400, \"application/json\", &json_error(&e))?;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n    };\n\n    // /admin/selftest 不触碰真实仓库。\n    if req.method == \"GET\" && req.path == \"/admin/selftest\" {\n        let report = selftest::run();\n        let body = report.render_text();\n        let status = if report.all_passed() { 200 } else { 500 };\n        return respond_text(stream, status, \"text/plain; charset=utf-8\", &body);\n    }\n\n    // POST /format 先特殊处理（重建文件后再打开仓库）。\n    if req.method == \"POST\" && req.path == \"/format\" {\n        RealStorage::create_files(dir)?;\n        let st = RealStorage::open(dir)?;\n        let repo = Repository::format(st).map_err(io_err)?;\n        return respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&repo.snapshot(), \"已格式化\"));\n    }\n\n    let st = RealStorage::open(dir)?;\n    let mut repo = match Repository::open(st) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => return respond_text(stream, 500, \"application/json\", &json_error(&e.to_string())),\n    };\n\n    route(stream, &mut repo, &req)\n}\n\nfn io_err<E: std::fmt::Display>(e: E) -> std::io::Error {\n    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e.to_string())\n}\n\nfn route(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    repo: &mut Repository<RealStorage>,\n    req: &Request,\n) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let (path, query) = split_query(&req.path);\n\n    match (req.method.as_str(), path) {\n        (\"GET\", \"/health\") => respond_json(stream, 200, &json_obj(&[(\"status\", json_str(\"ok\"))])),\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/snapshot\") => respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&repo.snapshot(), \"\")),\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/kv\") => {\n            let mut out = String::from(\"[\");\n            for (i, (k, v)) in repo.list().enumerate() {\n                if i > 0 {\n                    out.push(',');\n                }\n                out.push_str(&json_pair(k, v));\n            }\n            out.push(']');\n            respond_text(stream, 200, \"application/json\", &out)\n        }\n\n        (\"PUT\", \"/kv\") => {\n            // 简易 JSON 批量：{\"items\":[{\"key\": <str>, \"value\": <str>}]}\n            match parse_batch(&req.body) {\n                Ok(items) => {\n                    let snap = repo\n                        .put_batch(items.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.as_slice(), v.as_slice())))\n                        .map_err(io_err)?;\n                    respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&snap, \"批量写入已提交\"))\n                }\n                Err(msg) => respond_text(stream, 400, \"application/json\", &json_error(&msg)),\n            }\n        }\n\n        (m, p) if p.starts_with(\"/kv/\") => {\n            let key = percent_decode(&p[4..]);\n            match m {\n                \"GET\" => match repo.get(&key) {\n                    Some(value) => {\n                        if query.get(\"format\").map(String::as_str) == Some(\"json\") {\n                            let body = json_pair(&key, value);\n                            respond_text(stream, 200, \"application/json\", &body)\n                        } else {\n                            respond_bytes(stream, 200, \"application/octet-stream\", value)\n                        }\n                    }\n                    None => respond_text(stream, 404, \"application/json\", &json_error(\"键不存在\")),\n                },\n                \"PUT\" => {\n                    let value = if req.headers.iter().any(|(k, v)| {\n                        k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"x-value-base64\") && v.trim() == \"1\"\n                    }) {\n                        match base64_decode(std::str::from_utf8(&req.body).unwrap_or(\"\").trim()) {\n                            Some(v) => v,\n                            None => {\n                                return respond_text(\n                                    stream,\n                                    400,\n                                    \"application/json\",\n                                    &json_error(\"非法 base64 值\"),\n                                )\n                            }\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        req.body.clone()\n                    };\n                    let snap = repo\n                        .put_batch([(key.as_slice(), value.as_slice())])\n                        .map_err(io_err)?;\n                    respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&snap, \"写入已提交\"))\n                }\n                \"DELETE\" => {\n                    let snap = repo.delete_batch([key.as_slice()]).map_err(io_err)?;\n                    respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&snap, \"删除已提交\"))\n                }\n                _ => respond_text(stream, 405, \"application/json\", &json_error(\"方法不允许\")),\n            }\n        }\n\n        _ => respond_text(stream, 404, \"application/json\", &json_error(\"未知路由\")),\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================= HTTP 解析 =============================\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    headers: Vec<(String, String)>,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> Result<Request, String> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(8192);\n    let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n    let header_end;\n    loop {\n        let n = stream\n            .read(&mut tmp)\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"读取请求失败: {e}\"))?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(\"连接已关闭\".into());\n        }\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n        if let Some(pos) = find_subsequence(&buf, b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\") {\n            header_end = pos;\n            break;\n        }\n        if buf.len() > 16 * 1024 * 1024 {\n            return Err(\"请求头过大\".into());\n        }\n    }\n\n    let header_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = header_text.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line = lines.next().ok_or(\"缺少请求行\")?;\n    let mut parts = request_line.split_whitespace();\n    let method = parts.next().ok_or(\"缺少方法\")?.to_string();\n    let path = parts.next().ok_or(\"缺少路径\")?.to_string();\n    let _version = parts.next().ok_or(\"缺少 HTTP 版本\")?;\n\n    let mut headers = Vec::new();\n    let mut content_length = 0usize;\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once(':') {\n            let (k, v) = (k.trim().to_string(), v.trim().to_string());\n            if k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n                content_length = v.parse().map_err(|_| \"非法 Content-Length\")?;\n            }\n            headers.push((k, v));\n        }\n    }\n\n    let body_start = header_end + 4;\n    let mut body = buf[body_start..].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let n = stream\n            .read(&mut tmp)\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"读取 body 失败: {e}\"))?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        body.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n    }\n    body.truncate(content_length);\n\n    Ok(Request { method, path, headers, body })\n}\n\nfn find_subsequence(haystack: &[u8], needle: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {\n    haystack.windows(needle.len()).position(|w| w == needle)\n}\n\n// ============================= 响应 =============================\n\nfn respond_text(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    status: u16,\n    content_type: &str,\n    body: &str,\n) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    respond_bytes(stream, status, content_type, body.as_bytes())\n}\n\nfn respond_bytes(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    status: u16,\n    content_type: &str,\n    body: &[u8],\n) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let reason = match status {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        405 => \"Method Not Allowed\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        _ => \"OK\",\n    };\n    let head = format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {status} {reason}\\r\\nContent-Type: {content_type}\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes())?;\n    stream.write_all(body)?;\n    stream.flush()\n}\n\nfn respond_json(stream: &mut TcpStream, status: u16, body: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    respond_text(stream, status, \"application/json\", body)\n}\n\n// ============================= JSON / 编码辅助 =============================\n\nfn json_escape(bytes: &[u8], out: &mut String) {\n    out.push('\"');\n    for &b in bytes {\n        match b {\n            b'\"' => out.push_str(\"\\\\\\\"\"),\n            b'\\\\' => out.push_str(\"\\\\\\\\\"),\n            b'\\n' => out.push_str(\"\\\\n\"),\n            b'\\r' => out.push_str(\"\\\\r\"),\n            b'\\t' => out.push_str(\"\\\\t\"),\n            0x20..=0x7e => out.push(b as char),\n            other => out.push_str(&format!(\"\\\\u{:04x}\", other)),\n        }\n    }\n    out.push('\"');\n}\n\nfn json_str(s: &str) -> String {\n    let mut o = String::new();\n    json_escape(s.as_bytes(), &mut o);\n    o\n}\n\nfn json_error(msg: &str) -> String {\n    json_obj(&[(\"ok\", \"false\"), (\"error\", json_str(msg).as_str())])\n}\n\nfn json_obj(pairs: &[(&str, &str)]) -> String {\n    let mut out = String::from(\"{\");\n    for (i, (k, v)) in pairs.iter().enumerate() {\n        if i > 0 {\n            out.push(',');\n        }\n        out.push_str(&json_str(k));\n        out.push(':');\n        // 数字/裸值（如 false）直接放入，字符串已带引号。\n        if v.starts_with('\"') || *v == \"false\" || v.parse::<i64>().is_ok() {\n            out.push_str(v);\n        } else {\n            out.push_str(&json_str(v));\n        }\n    }\n    out.push('}');\n    out\n}\n\nfn json_pair(key: &[u8], value: &[u8]) -> String {\n    let mut o = String::from(\"{\\\"key\\\":\");\n    json_escape(key, &mut o);\n    o.push_str(\",\\\"value\\\":\");\n    json_escape(value, &mut o);\n    o.push('}');\n    o\n}\n\nfn json_snapshot(snap: &crate::store::Snapshot, note: &str) -> String {\n    let root_empty = snap.root.is_empty();\n    json_obj(&[\n        (\"ok\", \"true\"),\n        (\"generation\", &snap.generation.to_string()),\n        (\"entries\", &snap.entries.to_string()),\n        (\n            \"root\",\n            &json_obj(&[\n                (\"offset\", &snap.root.offset.to_string()),\n                (\"len\", &snap.root.len.to_string()),\n                (\"crc\", &format!(\"0x{:08x}\", snap.root.crc)),\n                (\"empty\", if root_empty { \"true\" } else { \"false\" }),\n            ]),\n        ),\n        (\"note\", note),\n    ])\n}\n\nfn split_query(path: &str) -> (String, std::collections::HashMap<String, String>) {\n    let mut q = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n    if let Some((p, query)) = path.split_once('?') {\n        for pair in query.split('&') {\n            if let Some((k, v)) = pair.split_once('=') {\n                q.insert(percent_decode(k), percent_decode(v));\n            }\n        }\n        (p.to_string(), q)\n    } else {\n        (path.to_string(), q)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 百分号解码（%XX 与 +）。非法转义原样保留。\nfn percent_decode(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        match bytes[i] {\n            b'%' if i + 2 < bytes.len() => {\n                let h = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[i + 1..i + 3]).ok().and_then(|x| u8::from_str_radix(x, 16).ok());\n                match h {\n                    Some(v) => {\n                        out.push(v);\n                        i += 3;\n                    }\n                    None => {\n                        out.push(b'%');\n                        i += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            b'+' => {\n                out.push(b' ');\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            b => {\n                out.push(b);\n                i += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n/// 极简标准字母表 base64 解码（HTTP 头传二进制值用）。\nfn base64_decode(s: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {\n    const T: &[u8] = b\"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\";\n    let mut val = [255u8; 256];\n    for (i, &c) in T.iter().enumerate() {\n        val[c as usize] = i as u8;\n    }\n    let s = s.trim_end_matches('=');\n    let mut out = Vec::new();\n    let mut acc: u32 = 0;\n    let mut bits = 0u32;\n    for c in s.bytes() {\n        if c == b'\\n' || c == b'\\r' {\n            continue;\n        }\n        let v = *val.get(c as usize)?;\n        if v == 255 {\n            return None;\n        }\n        acc = (acc << 6) | v as u32;\n        bits += 6;\n        if bits >= 8 {\n            bits -= 8;\n            out.push((acc >> bits) as u8);\n            acc &= (1 << bits) - 1;\n        }\n    }\n    Some(out)\n}\n\n/// 解析 `{\"items\":[{\"key\":\"...\",\"value\":\"...\"}]}`（键值均为 JSON 字符串）。\n/// 不做通用 JSON 解析器，只识别本服务自己文档化的固定形状。\nfn parse_batch(body: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<(String, String)>, String> {\n    let s = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| \"body 不是 UTF-8 JSON\")?;\n    let s = s.trim();\n    let start = s.find(\"\\\"items\\\"\").and_then(|p| s[p..].find('[')).map(|p| p + p).ok_or(\"缺少 items 数组\")?;\n    // 上面双重偏移易错，改为从头定位 '[' 与配对 ']'。\n    let arr_open = s.find('[').ok_or(\"缺少 items 数组\")?;\n    let arr_close = s.rfind(']').ok_or(\"items 数组未闭合\")?;\n    let inner = &s[arr_open + 1..arr_close];\n    let mut items = Vec::new();\n    for obj in split_top_objects(inner) {\n        let key = extract_json_string_field(obj, \"key\").ok_or(\"缺少字符串字段 key\")?;\n        let value = extract_json_string_field(obj, \"value\").ok_or(\"缺少字符串字段 value\")?;\n        items.push((key, value));\n    }\n    if items.is_empty() {\n        return Err(\"items 为空（至少需要一项）\".into());\n    }\n    let _ = start;\n    Ok(items)\n}\n\nfn split_top_objects(s: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n    let mut out = Vec::new();\n    let mut depth = 0i32;\n    let mut start = None;\n    let mut in_str = false;\n    let mut esc = false;\n    for (i, c) in s.char_indices() {\n        if in_str {\n            if esc {\n                esc = false;\n            } else if c == '\\\\' {\n                esc = true;\n            } else if c == '\"' {\n                in_str = false;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n        match c {\n            '\"' => in_str = true,\n            '{' => {\n                if depth == 0 {\n                    start = Some(i);\n                }\n                depth += 1;\n            }\n            '}' => {\n                depth -= 1;\n                if depth == 0 {\n                    if let Some(st) = start.take() {\n                        out.push(&s[st..=i]);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\nfn extract_json_string_field(obj: &str, field: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{field}\\\"\");\n    let p = obj.find(&pat)? + pat.len();\n    let rest = obj[p..].trim_start();\n    let rest = rest.strip_prefix(':')?.trim_start();\n    parse_json_string(rest)\n}\n\nfn parse_json_string(s: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let s = s.strip_prefix('\"')?;\n    let mut out = String::new();\n    let mut chars = s.char_indices();\n    while let Some((_, c)) = chars.next() {\n        match c {\n            '\"' => return Some(out),\n            '\\\\' => {\n                let (_, e) = chars.next()?;\n                match e {\n                    '\"' => out.push('\"'),\n                    '\\\\' => out.push('\\\\'),\n                    '/' =>
