| 格式化目录（截断重建）|\n//! | `GET  /kv/<key>` | 读取单键，不存在返回 404 |\n//! | `PUT  /kv/<key>` | 写入单键（请求体原样作为值；可用 `-H 'X-Value-Base64: 1'` 传二进制）|\n//! | `DELETE /kv/<key>` | 删除单键 |\n//! | `PUT  /kv` | 批量写，body 为 JSON：`{\"items\":[{\"key\":\"...\",\"value\":\"...\"}]}` |\n//! | `GET  /kv` | 列出全部键值（JSON 数组）|\n//! | `GET  /snapshot` | 当前代次、根指针、条目数 |\n//! | `GET  /admin/selftest` | 在模拟磁盘上跑全部崩溃恢复自检并返回报告 |\n//!\n//! 键按路径原样解释（UTF-8 字节）；特殊字符请先百分号编码。\n//! 响应统一为 JSON（`GET /kv/<key>` 默认返回原始字节，加 `?format=json` 返回 JSON）。\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse crate::io_layer::RealStorage;\nuse crate::selftest;\nuse crate::store::Repository;\n\npub struct HttpConfig {\n    pub addr: String,\n    pub dir: String,\n}\n\n/// 启动服务（阻塞）。目录未格式化时自动 format。\npub fn serve(cfg: &HttpConfig) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let dir = Path::new(&cfg.dir);\n    let data_exists = dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE).exists();\n    let super_exists = dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE).exists();\n    if !data_exists || !super_exists {\n        RealStorage::create_files(dir)?;\n        let st = RealStorage::open(dir)?;\n        Repository::format(st).expect(\"新介质格式化不应失败\");\n        eprintln!(\"[init] 已在 {} 完成格式化\", cfg.dir);\n    }\n\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(&cfg.addr)?;\n    eprintln!(\"[serve] 监听 http://{} ，数据目录 {}\", cfg.addr, cfg.dir);\n    for stream in listener.incoming() {\n        match stream {\n            Ok(mut stream) => {\n                let _ = stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)));\n                let _ = stream.set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)));\n                if let Err(e) = handle_connection(&mut stream, dir) {\n                    eprintln!(\"[warn] 连接处理出错: {e}\");\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => eprintln!(\"[warn] accept 失败: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn handle_connection(stream: &mut TcpStream, dir: &Path) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let req = match read_request(stream) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => {\n            respond_text(stream, 400, \"application/json\", &json_error(&e))?;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n    };\n\n    // /admin/selftest 不触碰真实仓库。\n    if req.method == \"GET\" && req.path == \"/admin/selftest\" {\n        let report = selftest::run();\n        let body = report.render_text();\n        let status = if report.all_passed() { 200 } else { 500 };\n        return respond_text(stream, status, \"text/plain; charset=utf-8\", &body);\n    }\n\n    // POST /format 先特殊处理（重建文件后再打开仓库）。\n    if req.method == \"POST\" && req.path == \"/format\" {\n        RealStorage::create_files(dir)?;\n        let st = RealStorage::open(dir)?;\n        let repo = Repository::format(st).map_err(io_err)?;\n        return respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&repo.snapshot(), \"已格式化\"));\n    }\n\n    let st = RealStorage::open(dir)?;\n    let mut repo = match Repository::open(st) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => return respond_text(stream, 500, \"application/json\", &json_error(&e.to_string())),\n    };\n\n    route(stream, &mut repo, &req)\n}\n\nfn io_err<E: std::fmt::Display>(e: E) -> std::io::Error {\n    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e.to_string())\n}\n\nfn route(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    repo: &mut Repository<RealStorage>,\n    req: &Request,\n) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let (path, query) = split_query(&req.path);\n\n    match (req.method.as_str(), path) {\n        (\"GET\", \"/health\") => respond_json(stream, 200, &json_obj(&[(\"status\", json_str(\"ok\"))])),\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/snapshot\") => respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&repo.snapshot(), \"\")),\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/kv\") => {\n            let mut out = String::from(\"[\");\n            for (i, (k, v)) in repo.list().enumerate() {\n                if i > 0 {\n                    out.push(',');\n                }\n                out.push_str(&json_pair(k, v));\n            }\n            out.push(']');\n            respond_text(stream, 200, \"application/json\", &out)\n        }\n\n        (\"PUT\", \"/kv\") => {\n            // 简易 JSON 批量：{\"items\":[{\"key\": <str>, \"value\": <str>}]}\n            match parse_batch(&req.body) {\n                Ok(items) => {\n                    let snap = repo\n                        .put_batch(items.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.as_slice(), v.as_slice())))\n                        .map_err(io_err)?;\n                    respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&snap, \"批量写入已提交\"))\n                }\n                Err(msg) => respond_text(stream, 400, \"application/json\", &json_error(&msg)),\n            }\n        }\n\n        (m, p) if p.starts_with(\"/kv/\") => {\n            let key = percent_decode(&p[4..]);\n            match m {\n                \"GET\" => match repo.get(&key) {\n                    Some(value) => {\n                        if query.get(\"format\").map(String::as_str) == Some(\"json\") {\n                            let body = json_pair(&key, value);\n                            respond_text(stream, 200, \"application/json\", &body)\n                        } else {\n                            respond_bytes(stream, 200, \"application/octet-stream\", value)\n                        }\n                    }\n                    None => respond_text(stream, 404, \"application/json\", &json_error(\"键不存在\")),\n                },\n                \"PUT\" => {\n                    let value = if req.headers.iter().any(|(k, v)| {\n                        k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"x-value-base64\") && v.trim() == \"1\"\n                    }) {\n                        match base64_decode(std::str::from_utf8(&req.body).unwrap_or(\"\").trim()) {\n                            Some(v) => v,\n                            None => {\n                                return respond_text(\n                                    stream,\n                                    400,\n                                    \"application/json\",\n                                    &json_error(\"非法 base64 值\"),\n                                )\n                            }\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        req.body.clone()\n                    };\n                    let snap = repo\n                        .put_batch([(key.as_slice(), value.as_slice())])\n                        .map_err(io_err)?;\n                    respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&snap, \"写入已提交\"))\n                }\n                \"DELETE\" => {\n                    let snap = repo.delete_batch([key.as_slice()]).map_err(io_err)?;\n                    respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&snap, \"删除已提交\"))\n                }\n                _ => respond_text(stream, 405, \"application/json\", &json_error(\"方法不允许\")),\n            }\n        }\n\n        _ => respond_text(stream, 404, \"application/json\", &json_error(\"未知路由\")),\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================= HTTP 解析 =============================\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    headers: Vec<(String, String)>,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> Result<Request, String> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(8192);\n    let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n    let header_end;\n    loop {\n        let n = stream\n            .read(&mut tmp)\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"读取请求失败: {e}\"))?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(\"连接已关闭\".into());\n        }\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n        if let Some(pos) = find_subsequence(&buf, b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\") {\n            header_end = pos;\n            break;\n        }\n        if buf.len() > 16 * 1024 * 1024 {\n            return Err(\"请求头过大\".into());\n        }\n    }\n\n    let header_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = header_text.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line = lines.next().ok_or(\"缺少请求行\")?;\n    let mut parts = request_line.split_whitespace();\n    let method = parts.next().ok_or(\"缺少方法\")?.to_string();\n    let path = parts.next().ok_or(\"缺少路径\")?.to_string();\n    let _version = parts.next().ok_or(\"缺少 HTTP 版本\")?;\n\n    let mut headers = Vec::new();\n    let mut content_length = 0usize;\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once(':') {\n            let (k, v) = (k.trim().to_string(), v.trim().to_string());\n            if k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n                content_length = v.parse().map_err(|_| \"非法 Content-Length\")?;\n            }\n            headers.push((k, v));\n        }\n    }\n\n    let body_start = header_end + 4;\n    let mut body = buf[body_start..].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let n = stream\n            .read(&mut tmp)\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"读取 body 失败: {e}\"))?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        body.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n    }\n    body.truncate(content_length);\n\n    Ok(Request { method, path, headers, body })\n}\n\nfn find_subsequence(haystack: &[u8], needle: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {\n    haystack.windows(needle.len()).position(|w| w == needle)\n}\n\n// ============================= 响应 =============================\n\nfn respond_text(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    status: u16,\n    content_type: &str,\n    body: &str,\n) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    respond_bytes(stream, status, content_type, body.as_bytes())\n}\n\nfn respond_bytes(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    status: u16,\n    content_type: &str,\n    body: &[u8],\n) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let reason = match status {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        405 => \"Method Not Allowed\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        _ => \"OK\",\n    };\n    let head = format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {status} {reason}\\r\\nContent-Type: {content_type}\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes())?;\n    stream.write_all(body)?;\n    stream.flush()\n}\n\nfn respond_json(stream: &mut TcpStream, status: u16, body: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    respond_text(stream, status, \"application/json\", body)\n}\n\n// ============================= JSON / 编码辅助 =============================\n\nfn json_escape(bytes: &[u8], out: &mut String) {\n    out.push('\"');\n    for &b in bytes {\n        match b {\n            b'\"' => out.push_str(\"\\\\\\\"\"),\n            b'\\\\' => out.push_str(\"\\\\\\\\\"),\n            b'\\n' => out.push_str(\"\\\\n\"),\n            b'\\r' => out.push_str(\"\\\\r\"),\n            b'\\t' => out.push_str(\"\\\\t\"),\n            0x20..=0x7e => out.push(b as char),\n            other => out.push_str(&format!(\"\\\\u{:04x}\", other)),\n        }\n    }\n    out.push('\"');\n}\n\nfn json_str(s: &str) -> String {\n    let mut o = String::new();\n    json_escape(s.as_bytes(), &mut o);\n    o\n}\n\nfn json_error(msg: &str) -> String {\n    json_obj(&[(\"ok\", \"false\"), (\"error\", json_str(msg).as_str())])\n}\n\nfn json_obj(pairs: &[(&str, &str)]) -> String {\n    let mut out = String::from(\"{\");\n    for (i, (k, v)) in pairs.iter().enumerate() {\n        if i > 0 {\n            out.push(',');\n        }\n        out.push_str(&json_str(k));\n        out.push(':');\n        // 数字/裸值（如 false）直接放入，字符串已带引号。\n        if v.starts_with('\"') || *v == \"false\" || v.parse::<i64>().is_ok() {\n            out.push_str(v);\n        } else {\n            out.push_str(&json_str(v));\n        }\n    }\n    out.push('}');\n    out\n}\n\nfn json_pair(key: &[u8], value: &[u8]) -> String {\n    let mut o = String::from(\"{\\\"key\\\":\");\n    json_escape(key, &mut o);\n    o.push_str(\",\\\"value\\\":\");\n    json_escape(value, &mut o);\n    o.push('}');\n    o\n}\n\nfn json_snapshot(snap: &crate::store::Snapshot, note: &str) -> String {\n    let root_empty = snap.root.is_empty();\n    json_obj(&[\n        (\"ok\", \"true\"),\n        (\"generation\", &snap.generation.to_string()),\n        (\"entries\", &snap.entries.to_string()),\n        (\n            \"root\",\n            &json_obj(&[\n                (\"offset\", &snap.root.offset.to_string()),\n                (\"len\", &snap.root.len.to_string()),\n                (\"crc\", &format!(\"0x{:08x}\", snap.root.crc)),\n                (\"empty\", if root_empty { \"true\" } else { \"false\" }),\n            ]),\n query)) = path.split_once('?') {\n        for pair in query.split('&') {\n            if let Some((k, v)) = pair.split_once('=') {\n                q.insert(percent_decode(k), percent_decode(v));\n            }\n        }\n        (p.to_string(), q)\n    } else {\n        (path.to_string(), q)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 百分号解码（%XX 与 +）。非法转义原样保留。\nfn percent_decode(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        match bytes[i] {\n            b'%' if i + 2 < bytes.len() => {\n                let h = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[i + 1..i + 3]).ok().and_then(|x| u8::from_str_radix(x, 16).ok());\n                match h {\n                    Some(v) => {\n                        out.push(v);\n                        i += 3;\n                    }\n                    None => {\n                        out.push(b'%');\n                        i += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            b'+' => {\n                out.push(b' ');\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            b => {\n                out.push(b);\n                i += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n/// 极简标准字母表 base64 解码（HTTP 头传二进制值用）。\nfn base64_decode(s: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {\n    const T: &[u8] = b\"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\";\n    let mut val = [255u8; 256];\n    for (i, &c) in T.iter().enumerate() {\n        val[c as usize] = i as u8;\n    }\n    let s = s.trim_end_matches('=');\n    let mut out = Vec::new();\n    let mut acc: u32 = 0;\n    let mut bits = 0u32;\n    for c in s.bytes() {\n        if c == b'\\n' || c == b'\\r' {\n            continue;\n        }\n        let v = *val.get(c as usize)?;\n        if v == 255 {\n            return None;\n        }\n        acc = (acc << 6) | v as u32;\n        bits += 6;\n        if bits >= 8 {\n            bits -= 8;\n            out.push((acc >> bits) as u8);\n            acc &= (1 << bits) - 1;\n        }\n    }\n    Some(out)\n}\n\n/// 解析 `{\"items\":[{\"key\":\"...\",\"value\":\"...\"}]}`（键值均为 JSON 字符串）。\n/// 不做通用 JSON 解析器，只识别本服务自己文档化的固定形状。\nfn parse_batch(body: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<(String, String)>, String> {\n    let s = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| \"body 不是 UTF-8 JSON\")?;\n    let s = s.trim();\n    let start = s.find(\"\\\"items\\\"\").and_then(|p| s[p..].find('[')).map(|p| p + p).ok_or(\"缺少 items 数组\")?;\n    // 上面双重偏移易错，改为从头定位 '[' 与配对 ']'。\n    let arr_open = s.find('[').ok_or(\"缺少 items 数组\")?;\n    let arr_close = s.rfind(']').ok_or(\"items 数组未闭合\")?;\n    let inner = &s[arr_open + 1..arr_close];\n    let mut items = Vec::new();\n    for obj in split_top_objects(inner) {\n        let key = extract_json_string_field(obj, \"key\").ok_or(\"缺少字符串字段 key\")?;\n        let value = extract_json_string_field(obj, \"value\").ok_or(\"缺少字符串字段 value\")?;\n        items.push((key, value));\n    }\n    if items.is_empty() {\n        return Err(\"items 为空（至少需要一项）\".into());\n    }\n    let _ = start;\n    Ok(items)\n}\n\nfn split_top_objects(s: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n    let mut out = Vec::new();\n    let mut depth = 0i32;\n    let mut start = None;\n    let mut in_str = false;\n    let mut esc = false;\n    for (i, c) in s.char_indices() {\n        if in_str {\n            if esc {\n                esc = false;\n            } else if c == '\\\\' {\n                esc = true;\n            } else if c == '\"' {\n                in_str = false;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n        match c {\n            '\"' => in_str = true,\n            '{' => {\n                if depth == 0 {\n                    start = Some(i);\n                }\n                depth += 1;\n            }\n            '}' => {\n                depth -= 1;\n                if depth == 0 {\n                    if let Some(st) = start.take() {\n                        out.push(&s[st..=i]);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\nfn extract_json_string_field(obj: &str, field: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{field}\\\"\");\n    let p = obj.find(&pat)? + pat.len();\n    let rest = obj[p..].trim_start();\n    let rest = rest.strip_prefix(':')?.trim_start();\n    parse_json_string(rest)\n}\n\nfn parse_json_string(s: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let s = s.strip_prefix('\"')?;\n    let mut out = String::new();\n    let mut chars = s.char_indices();\n    while let Some((_, c)) = chars.next() {\n        match c {\n            '\"' => return Some(out),\n            '\\\\' => {\n                let (_, e) = chars.next()?;\n                match e {\n                    '\"' => out.push('\"'),\n                    '\\\\' => out.push('\\\\'),\n                    '/' => out.push('/'),\n                    'n' => out.push('\\n'),\n                    't' => out.push('\\t'),\n                    'r' => out.push('\\r'),\n                    'u' => {\n                        let hex: String = (0..4).filter_map(|_| chars.next().map(|(_, c)| c)).collect();\n                        let code = u32::from_str_radix(&hex, 16).ok()?;\n                        if let Some(ch) = 本地 HTTP 验证入口。\n//!\n//! 仅依赖标准库手写的最小 HTTP/1.1 服务，**单线程顺序处理**（本地验证足够，\n//! 且让提交协议的同步语义清晰可观察）。\n//!\n//! # 路由\n//!\n//! | 方法 路径 | 说明 |\n//! |---|---|\n//! | `GET  /health` | 存活检查 |\n//! | `POST /format` | 格式化目录（截断重建）|\n//! | `GET  /kv/<key>` | 读取单键，不存在返回 404 |\n//! | `PUT  /kv/<key>` | 写入单键（请求体原样作为值；可用 `-H 'X-Value-Base64: 1'` 传二进制）|\n//! | `DELETE /kv/<key>` | 删除单键 |\n//! | `PUT  /kv` | 批量写，body 为 JSON：`{\"items\":[{\"key\":\"...\",\"value\":\"...\"}]}` |\n//! | `GET  /kv` | 列出全部键值（JSON 数组）|\n//! | `GET  /snapshot` | 当前代次、根指针、条目数 |\n//! | `GET  /admin/selftest` | 在模拟磁盘上跑全部崩溃恢复自检并返回报告 |\n//!\n//! 键按路径原样解释（UTF-8 字节）；特殊字符请先百分号编码。\n//! 响应统一为 JSON（`GET /kv/<key>` 默认返回原始字节，加 `?format=json` 返回 JSON）。\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse crate::io_layer::RealStorage;\nuse crate::selftest;\nuse crate::store::Repository;\n\npub struct HttpConfig {\n    pub addr: String,\n    pub dir: String,\n}\n\n/// 启动服务（阻塞）。目录未格式化时自动 format。\npub fn serve(cfg: &HttpConfig) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let dir = Path::new(&cfg.dir);\n    let data_exists = dir.join(crate::format::DATA_FILE).exists();\n    let super_exists = dir.join(crate::format::SUPER_FILE).exists();\n    if !data_exists || !super_exists {\n        RealStorage::create_files(dir)?;\n        let st = RealStorage::open(dir)?;\n        Repository::format(st).expect(\"新介质格式化不应失败\");\n        eprintln!(\"[init] 已在 {} 完成格式化\", cfg.dir);\n    }\n\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(&cfg.addr)?;\n    eprintln!(\"[serve] 监听 http://{} ，数据目录 {}\", cfg.addr, cfg.dir);\n    for stream in listener.incoming() {\n        match stream {\n            Ok(mut stream) => {\n                let _ = stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)));\n                let _ = stream.set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)));\n                if let Err(e) = handle_connection(&mut stream, dir) {\n                    eprintln!(\"[warn] 连接处理出错: {e}\");\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => eprintln!(\"[warn] accept 失败: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn handle_connection(stream: &mut TcpStream, dir: &Path) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let req = match read_request(stream) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => {\n            respond_text(stream, 400, \"application/json\", &json_error(&e))?;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n    };\n\n    // /admin/selftest 不触碰真实仓库。\n    if req.method == \"GET\" && req.path == \"/admin/selftest\" {\n        let report = selftest::run();\n        let body = report.render_text();\n        let status = if report.all_passed() { 200 } else { 500 };\n        return respond_text(stream, status, \"text/plain; charset=utf-8\", &body);\n    }\n\n    // POST /format 先特殊处理（重建文件后再打开仓库）。\n    if req.method == \"POST\" && req.path == \"/format\" {\n        RealStorage::create_files(dir)?;\n        let st = RealStorage::open(dir)?;\n        let repo = Repository::format(st).map_err(io_err)?;\n        return respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&repo.snapshot(), \"已格式化\"));\n    }\n\n    let st = RealStorage::open(dir)?;\n    let mut repo = match Repository::open(st) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => return respond_text(stream, 500, \"application/json\", &json_error(&e.to_string())),\n    };\n\n    route(stream, &mut repo, &req)\n}\n\nfn io_err<E: std::fmt::Display>(e: E) -> std::io::Error {\n    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e.to_string())\n}\n\nfn route(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    repo: &mut Repository<RealStorage>,\n    req: &Request,\n) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let (path, query) = split_query(&req.path);\n\n    match (req.method.as_str(), path) {\n        (\"GET\", \"/health\") => respond_json(stream, 200, &json_obj(&[(\"status\", json_str(\"ok\"))])),\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/snapshot\") => respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&repo.snapshot(), \"\")),\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/kv\") => {\n            let mut out = String::from(\"[\");\n            for (i, (k, v)) in repo.list().enumerate() {\n                if i > 0 {\n                    out.push(',');\n                }\n                out.push_str(&json_pair(k, v));\n            }\n            out.push(']');\n            respond_text(stream, 200, \"application/json\", &out)\n        }\n\n        (\"PUT\", \"/kv\") => {\n            // 简易 JSON 批量：{\"items\":[{\"key\": <str>, \"value\": <str>}]}\n            match parse_batch(&req.body) {\n                Ok(items) => {\n                    let snap = repo\n                        .put_batch(items.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.as_slice(), v.as_slice())))\n                        .map_err(io_err)?;\n                    respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&snap, \"批量写入已提交\"))\n                }\n                Err(msg) => respond_text(stream, 400, \"application/json\", &json_error(&msg)),\n            }\n        }\n\n        (m, p) if p.starts_with(\"/kv/\") => {\n            let key = percent_decode(&p[4..]);\n            match m {\n                \"GET\" => match repo.get(&key) {\n                    Some(value) => {\n                        if query.get(\"format\").map(String::as_str) == Some(\"json\") {\n                            let body = json_pair(&key, value);\n                            respond_text(stream, 200, \"application/json\", &body)\n                        } else {\n                            respond_bytes(stream, 200, \"application/octet-stream\", value)\n                        }\n                    }\n                    None => respond_text(stream, 404, \"application/json\", &json_error(\"键不存在\")),\n                },\n                \"PUT\" => {\n                    let value = if req.headers.iter().any(|(k, v)| {\n                        k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"x-value-base64\") && v.trim() == \"1\"\n                    }) {\n                        match base64_decode(std::str::from_utf8(&req.body).unwrap_or(\"\").trim()) {\n                            Some(v) => v,\n                            None => {\n                                return respond_text(\n                                    stream,\n                                    400,\n                                    \"application/json\",\n                                    &json_error(\"非法 base64 值\"),\n                                )\n                            }\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        req.body.clone()\n                    };\n                    let snap = repo\n                        .put_batch([(key.as_slice(), value.as_slice())])\n                        .map_err(io_err)?;\n                    respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&snap, \"写入已提交\"))\n                }\n                \"DELETE\" => {\n                    let snap = repo.delete_batch([key.as_slice()]).map_err(io_err)?;\n                    respond_json(stream, 200, &json_snapshot(&snap, \"删除已提交\"))\n                }\n                _ => respond_text(stream, 405, \"application/json\", &json_error(\"方法不允许\")),\n            }\n        }\n\n        _ => respond_text(stream, 404, \"application/json\", &json_error(\"未知路由\")),\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================= HTTP 解析 =============================\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    headers: Vec<(String, String)>,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> Result<Request, String> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(8192);\n    let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n    let header_end;\n    loop {\n        let n = stream\n            .read(&mut tmp)\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"读取请求失败: {e}\"))?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(\"连接已关闭\".into());\n        }\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n        if let Some(pos) = find_subsequence(&buf, b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\") {\n            header_end = pos;\n            break;\n        }\n        if buf.len() > 16 * 1024 * 1024 {\n            return Err(\"请求头过大\".into());\n        }\n    }\n\n    let header_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = header_text.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line = lines.next().ok_or(\"缺少请求行\")?;\n    let mut parts = request_line.split_whitespace();\n    let method = parts.next().ok_or(\"缺少方法\")?.to_string();\n    let path = parts.next().ok_or(\"缺少路径\")?.to_string();\n    let _version = parts.next().ok_or(\"缺少 HTTP 版本\")?;\n\n    let mut headers = Vec::new();\n    let mut content_length = 0usize;\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once(':') {\n            let (k, v) = (k.trim().to_string(), v.trim().to_string());\n            if k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n                content_length = v.parse().map_err(|_| \"非法 Content-Length\")?;\n            }\n            headers.push((k, v));\n        }\n    }\n\n    let body_start = header_end + 4;\n    let mut body = buf[body_start..].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let n = stream\n            .read(&mut tmp)\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"读取 body 失败: {e}\"))?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        body.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n    }\n    body.truncate(content_length);\n\n    Ok(Request { method, path, headers, body })\n}\n\nfn find_subsequence(haystack: &[u8], needle: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {\n    haystack.windows(needle.len()).position(|w| w == needle)\n}\n\n// ============================= 响应 =============================\n\nfn respond_text(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    status: u16,\n    content_type: &str,\n    body: &str,\n) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    respond_bytes(stream, status, content_type, body.as_bytes())\n}\n\nfn respond_bytes(\n    stream: &mut TcpStream,\n    status: u16,\n    content_type: &str,\n    body: &[u8],\n) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let reason = match status {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        405 => \"Method Not Allowed\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        _ => \"OK\",\n    };\n    let head = format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {status} {reason}\\r\\nContent-Type: {content_type}\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes())?;\n    stream.write_all(body)?;\n    stream.flush()\n}\n\nfn respond_json(stream: &mut TcpStream, status: u16, body: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    respond_text(stream, status, \"application/json\", body)\n}\n\n// ============================= JSON / 编码辅助 =============================\n\nfn json_escape(bytes: &[u8], out: &mut String) {\n    out.push('\"');\n    for &b in bytes {\n        match b {\n            b'\"' => out.push_str(\"\\\\\\\"\"),\n            b'\\\\' => out.push_str(\"\\\\\\\\\"),\n            b'\\n' => out.push_str(\"\\\\n\"),\n            b'\\r' => out.push_str(\"\\\\r\"),\n            b'\\t' => out.push_str(\"\\\\t\"),\n            0x20..=0x7e => out.push(b as char),\n            other => out.push_str(&format!(\"\\\\u{:04x}\", other)),\n        }\n    }\n    out.push('\"');\n}\n\nfn json_str(s: &str) -> String {\n    let mut o = String::new();\n    json_escape(s.as_bytes(), &mut o);\n    o\n}\n\nfn json_error(msg: &str) -> String {\n    json_obj(&[(\"ok\", \"false\"), (\"error\", json_str(msg).as_str())])\n}\n\nfn json_obj(pairs: &[(&str, &str)]) -> String {\n    let mut out = String::from(\"{\");\n    for (i, (k, v)) in pairs.iter().enumerate() {\n        if i > 0 {\n            out.push(',');\n        }\n        out.push_str(&json_str(k));\n        out.push(':');\n        // 数字/裸值（如 false）直接放入，字符串已带引号。\n        if v.starts_with('\"') || *v == \"false\" || v.parse::<i64>().is_ok() {\n            out.push_str(v);\n        } else {\n            out.push_str(&json_str(v));\n        }\n    }\n    out.push('}');\n    out\n}\n\nfn json_pair(key: &[u8], value: &[u8]) -> String {\n    let mut o = String::from(\"{\\\"key\\\":\");\n    json_escape(key, &mut o);\n    o.push_str(\",\\\"value\\\":\");\n    json_escape(value, &mut o);\n    o.push('}');\n    o\n}\n\nfn json_snapshot(snap: &crate::store::Snapshot, note: &str) -> String {\n    let root_empty = snap.root.is_empty();\n    json_obj(&[\n        (\"ok\", \"true\"),\n        (\"generation\", &snap.generation.to_string()),\n        (\"entries\", &snap.entries.to_string()),\n        (\n            \"root\",\n            &json_obj(&[\n                (\"offset\", &snap.root.offset.to_string()),\n                (\"len\", &snap.root.len.to_string()),\n                (\"crc\", &format!(\"0x{:08x}\", snap.root.crc)),\n                (\"empty\", if root_empty { \"true\" } else { \"false\" }),\n            ]),\n        ),\n        (\"note\", note),\n    ])\n}\n\nfn split_query(path: &str) -> (String, std::collections::HashMap<String, String>) {\n    let mut q = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n    if let Some((p, query)) = path.split_once('?') {\n        for pair in query.split('&') {\n            if let Some((k, v)) = pair.split_once('=') {\n                q.insert(percent_decode(k), percent_decode(v));\n            }\n        }\n        (p.to_string(), q)\n    } else {\n        (path.to_string(), q)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 百分号解码（%XX 与 +）。非法转义原样保留。\nfn percent_decode(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        match bytes[i] {\n            b'%' if i + 2 < bytes.len() => {\n                let h = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[i + 1..i + 3]).ok().and_then(|x| u8::from_str_radix(x, 16).ok());\n                match h {\n                    Some(v) => {\n                        out.push(v);\n                        i += 3;\n                    }\n                    None => {\n                        out.push(b'%');\n                        i += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            b'+' => {\n                out.push(b' ');\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            b => {\n                out.push(b);\n                i += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n/// 极简标准字母表 base64 解码（HTTP 头传二进制值用）。\nfn base64_decode(s: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {\n    const T: &[u8] = b\"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\";\n    let mut val = [255u8; 256];\n    for (i, &c) in T.iter().enumerate() {\n        val[c as usize] = i as u8;\n    }\n    let s = s.trim_end_matches('=');\n    let mut out = Vec::new();\n    let mut acc: u32 = 0;\n    let mut bits = 0u32;\n    for c in s.bytes() {\n        if c == b'\\n' || c == b'\\r' {\n            continue;\n        }\n        let v = *val.get(c as usize)?;\n        if v == 255 {\n            return None;\n        }\n        acc = (acc << 6) | v as u32;\n        bits += 6;\n        if bits >= 8 {\n            bits -= 8;\n            out.push((acc >> bits) as u8);\n            acc &= (1 << bits) - 1;\n        }\n    }\n    Some(out)\n}\n\n/// 解析 `{\"items\":[{\"key\":\"...\",\"value\":\"...\"}]}`（键值均为 JSON 字符串）。\n/// 不做通用 JSON 解析器，只识别本服务自己文档化的固定形状。\nfn parse_batch(body: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<(String, String)>, String> {\n    let s = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| \"body 不是 UTF-8 JSON\")?;\n    let s = s.trim();\n    let start = s.find(\"\\\"items\\\"\").and_then(|p| s[p..].find('[')).map(|p| p + p).ok_or(\"缺少 items 数组\")?;\n    // 上面双重偏移易错，改为从头定位 '[' 与配对 ']'。\n    let arr_open = s.find('[').ok_or(\"缺少 items 数组\")?;\n    let arr_close = s.rfind(']').ok_or(\"items 数组未闭合\")?;\n    let inner = &s[arr_open + 1..arr_close];\n    let mut items = Vec::new();\n    for obj in split_top_objects(inner) {\n        let key = extract_json_string_field(obj, \"key\").ok_or(\"缺少字符串字段 key\")?;\n        let value = extract_json_string_field(obj, \"value\").ok_or(\"缺少字符串字段 value\")?;\n        items.push((key, value));\n    }\n    if items.is_empty() {\n        return Err(\"items 为空（至少需要一项）\".into());\n    }\n    let _ = start;\n    Ok(items)\n}\n\nfn split_top_objects(s: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n    let mut out = Vec::new();\n    let mut depth = 0i32;\n    let mut start = None;\n    let mut in_str = false;\n    let mut esc = false;\n    for (i, c) in s.char_indices() {\n        if in_str {\n            if esc {\n                esc = false;\n            } else if c == '\\\\' {\n                esc = true;\n            } else if c == '\"' {\n                in_str = false;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n        match c {\n            '\"' => in_str = true,\n            '{' => {\n                if depth == 0 {\n                    start = Some(i);\n                }\n                depth += 1;\n            }\n            '}' => {\n                depth -= 1;\n                if depth == 0 {\n                    if let Some(st) = start.take() {\n                        out.push(&s[st..=i]);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\nfn extract_json_string_field(obj: &str, field: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{field}\\\"\");\n    let p = obj.find(&pat)? + pat.len();\n    let rest = obj[p..].trim_start();\n    let rest = rest.strip_prefix(':')?.trim_start();\n    parse_json_string(rest)\n}\n\nfn parse_json_string(s: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let s = s.strip_prefix('\"')?;\n    let mut out = String::new();\n    let mut chars = s.char_indices();\n    while let Some((_, c)) = chars.next() {\n        match c {\n            '\"' => return Some(out),\n            '\\\\' => {\n                let (_, e) = chars.next()?;\n                match e {\n                    '\"' => out.push('\"'),\n                    '\\\\' => out.push('\\\\'),\n                    '/' => out.push('/'),\n                    'n' => out.push('\\n'),\n                    't' => out.push('\\t'),\n                    'r' => out.push('\\r'),\n                    'u' => {\n                        let hex: String = (0..4).filter_map(|_| chars.next().map(|(_, c)| c)).collect();\n                        let code = u32::from_str_radix(&hex, 16).ok()?;\n                        if let Some(ch) = char::from_u32(code) {\n                            out.push(ch);\n                        }\n                    }\n                    _ => return None,\n                }\n            }\n            other => out.push(other),\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0c7b43b4-b0c2-44a9-8863-938d5ff7601f","session_id":"aa155883-6d0d-48f5-bfbf-9f0daaa5a572","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a","sessionId":"aa155883-6d0d-48f5-bfbf-9f0daaa5a572","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp1-a","slug":"tender-tinkering-wave"}

{"parentUuid":"95cd40d2-c218-4ec5-953a-f58a3944baa1","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_2i9wpzpd590jzdfmjptc4sza","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a/src/main.rs","content":"//! 命令行入口：\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! dual-superblock serve    [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080] [--dir ./storedata]\n//! dual-superblock format   [--dir ./storedata]\n//! dual-superblock selftest\n//! ```\n\nuse std::process::ExitCode;\n\nuse dual_superblock::http_server::{serve, HttpConfig};\nuse dual_superblock::io_layer::RealStorage;\nuse dual_superblock::selftest;\nuse dual_superblock::store::Repository;\n\nfn main() -> ExitCode {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();\n    let (cmd, rest) = match args.split_first() {\n        Some((c, r)) => (c.as_str(), r),\n        None => {\n            print_usage();\n            return ExitCode::from(2);\n        }\n    };\n\n    match cmd {\n        \"serve\" => {\n            let cfg = parse_http_args(rest);\n            if let Err(e) = serve(&cfg) {\n                eprintln!(\"服务退出: {e}\");\n                return ExitCode::FAILURE;\n            }\n            ExitCode::SUCCESS\n        }\n        \"format\" => {\n            let dir = flag_value(rest, \"--dir\").unwrap_or_else(|| \"./storedata\".into());\n            match RealStorage::create_files(std::path::Path::new(&dir)).and_then(|()| {\n                let st = RealStorage::open(std::path::Path::new(&dir))?;\n                Repository::format(st).map_err(real_err)?;\n                Ok(())\n            }) {\n                Ok(()) => {\n                    println!(\"已在 {dir} 完成格式化（代次0，空根，超级块槽位0）\");\n                    ExitCode::SUCCESS\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    eprintln!(\"格式化失败: {e}\");\n                    ExitCode::FAILURE\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        \"selftest\" => {\n            let report = selftest::run();\n            print!(\"{}\", report.render_text());\n            if report.all_passed() {\n                ExitCode::SUCCESS\n            } else {\n                ExitCode::FAILURE\n            }\n        }\n        \"-h\" | \"--help\" | \"help\" => {\n            print_usage();\n            ExitCode::SUCCESS\n        }\n        other => {\n            eprintln!(\"未知子命令: {other}\");\n            print_usage();\n            ExitCode::from(2)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn real_err<E: std::fmt::Display>(e: E) -> std::io::Error {\n    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e.to_string())\n}\n\nfn parse_http_args(args: &[String]) -> HttpConfig {\n    HttpConfig {\n        addr: flag_value(args, \"--addr\").unwrap_or_else(|| \"127.0.0.1:8080\".into()),\n        dir: flag_value(args, \"--dir\").unwrap_or_else(|| \"./storedata\".into()),\n    }\n}\n\nfn flag_value(args: &[String], flag: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    args.iter()\n        .position(|a| a == flag)\n        .and_then(|i| args.get(i + 1))\n        .cloned()\n}\n\nfn print_usage() {\n    eprintln!(\n        \"dual-superblock —— 双页超级块恢复演示（纯后端）\\n\\\n         \\n\\\n         用法:\\n  \\\n         dual-superblock serve    [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080] [--dir ./storedata]\\n  \\\n         dual-superblock format   [--dir ./storedata]\\n  \\\n         dual-superblock selftest\\n  \\\n         dual-superblock help\\n\"\n    );\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_10cfeff5caec4ae60e1a821c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1164,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":71480,"output_tokens":1046,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_2i9wpzpd590jzdfmjptc4sza":{"content":"//! 命令行入口：\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! dual-superblock serve    [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080] [--dir ./storedata]\n//! dual-superblock format   [--dir ./storedata]\n//! dual-superblock selftest\n//! ```\n\nuse std::process::ExitCode;\n\nuse dual_superblock::http_server::{serve, HttpConfig};\nuse dual_superblock::io_layer::RealStorage;\nuse dual_superblock::selftest;\nuse dual_superblock::store::Repository;\n\nfn main() -> ExitCode {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();\n    let (cmd, rest) = match args.split_first() {\n        Some((c, r)) => (c.as_str(), r),\n        None => {\n            print_usage();\n            return ExitCode::from(2);\n        }\n    };\n\n    match cmd {\n        \"serve\" => {\n            let cfg = parse_http_args(rest);\n            if let Err(e) = serve(&cfg) {\n                eprintln!(\"服务退出: {e}\");\n                return ExitCode::FAILURE;\n            }\n            ExitCode::SUCCESS\n        }\n        \"format\" => {\n            let dir = flag_value(rest, \"--dir\").unwrap_or_else(|| \"./storedata\".into());\n            match RealStorage::create_files(std::path::Path::new(&dir)).and_then(|()| {\n                let st = RealStorage::open(std::path::Path::new(&dir))?;\n                Repository::format(st).map_err(real_err)?;\n                Ok(())\n            }) {\n                Ok(()) => {\n                    println!(\"已在 {dir} 完成格式化（代次0，空根，超级块槽位0）\");\n                    ExitCode::SUCCESS\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    eprintln!(\"格式化失败: {e}\");\n                    ExitCode::FAILURE\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        \"selftest\" => {\n            let report = selftest::run();\n            print!(\"{}\", report.render_text());\n            if report.all_passed() {\n                ExitCode::SUCCESS\n            } else {\n                ExitCode::FAILURE\n            }\n        }\n        \"-h\" | \"--help\" | \"help\" => {\n            print_usage();\n            ExitCode::SUCCESS\n        }\n        other => {\n            eprintln!(\"未知子命令: {other}\");\n            print_usage();\n            ExitCode::from(2)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn real_err<E: std::fmt::Display>(e: E) -> std::io::Error {\n    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e.to_string())\n}\n\nfn parse_http_args(args: &[String]) -> HttpConfig {\n    HttpConfig {\n        addr: flag_value(args, \"--addr\").unwrap_or_else(|| \"127.0.0.1:8080\".into()),\n        dir: flag_value(args, \"--dir\").unwrap_or_else(|| \"./storedata\".into()),\n    }\n}\n\nfn flag_value(args: &[String], flag: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    args.iter()\n        .position(|a| a == flag)\n        .and_then(|i| args.get(i + 1))\n        .cloned()\n}\n\nfn print_usage() {\n    eprintln!(\n        \"dual-superblock ——  \\\n         dual-superblock selftest\\n  \\\n         dual-superblock help\\n\"\n    );\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d830dc44-eb7a-45fe-b81f-0913c556048e","session_id":"aa155883-6d0d-48f5-bfbf-9f0daaa5a572","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a","sessionId":"aa155883-6d0d-48f5-bfbf-9f0daaa5a572","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp1-a","slug":"tender-tinkering-wave"}

// 翻转根偏移字段\n        assert_eq!(decode_super_page(&bad), None);\n\n        let zeros = vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        assert_eq!(decode_super_page(&zeros), None);\n\n        let empty = SuperBlock { generation: 0, root: Ptr::empty() };\n        assert_eq!(decode_super_page(&encode_super_page(&empty)), Some(empty));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn super_page_rejects_torn_writes() {\n        let sb = SuperBlock { generation: 4, root: Ptr { offset: 100, len: 60, crc: 777 } };\n        let page = encode_super_page(&sb);\n\n        // 半页写：前 2048 字节是新页，后 2048 字节是另一页（模拟旧槽位残留）。\n        let other = encode_super_page(&SuperBlock {\n            generation: 2,\n            root: Ptr { offset: 10, len: 40, crc: 55 },\n        });\n        let mut mixed = vec![0u8; PAGE_SIZE];\n        mixed[..2048].copy_from_slice(&page[..2048]);\n        mixed[2048..].copy_from_slice(&other[2048..]);\n        // 混合页 CRC 必然不符。\n        assert_eq!(decode_super_page(&mixed), None);\n\n        // 即使有人重算 CRC 使混合页通过校验，页首代次(4)与页尾副本(2)不一致，\n        // 尾戳仍会拒绝它。\n        let mut forged = mixed.clone();\n        let mut c = crate::crc::Crc32::new();\n        c.update(&forged[..34]);\n        c.update(&[0, 0, 0, 0]);\n        c.update(&forged[38..]);\n        put_u32(&mut forged[34..38], c.finalize());\n        assert_eq!(decode_super_page(&forged), None);\n    }","originalFile":null,"structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":468,"oldLines":6,"newStart":468,"newLines":33,"lines":["     }"," ","     #[test]","+    fn super_page_rejects_torn_writes() {","+        let sb = SuperBlock { generation: 4, root: Ptr { offset: 100, len: 60, crc: 777 } };","+        let page = encode_super_page(&sb);","+","+        // 半页写：前 2048 字节是新页，后 2048 字节是另一页（模拟旧槽位残留）。","+        let other = encode_super_page(&SuperBlock {","+            generation: 2,","+            root: Ptr { offset: 10, len: 40, crc: 55 },","+        });","+        let mut mixed = vec![0u8; {"parentUuid":"1b921100-0ac6-40d1-abfd-520e90e336cc","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_udkgmkfw2x4rizwoc3bet3cp","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a/tests/recovery.rs","content":"//! 集成测试：在模拟磁盘上穷举“多次提交 × 每个故障点”，并覆盖\n//! 多键批次、删除、代次单调性等额外不变量。\n\nuse dual_superblock::io_layer::{FaultKind, FaultRule, Op, SimDisk, Target};\nuse dual_superblock::selftest;\nuse dual_superblock::store::Repository;\n\nfn reopen(disk: &SimDisk) -> Repository<dual_superblock::io_layer::SimStorage> {\n    Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![])).expect(\"重新挂载不应失败\")\n}\n\nfn fresh_with_commits(n: u64) -> SimDisk {\n    let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n    let mut repo = Repository::format(disk.storage(vec![])).unwrap();\n    for g in 1..=n {\n        let key = format!(\"key{g}\");\n        repo.put_batch([(key.as_bytes(), vec![g as u8; 4].as_slice())])\n            .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!(\"提交代次 {g} 失败: {e}\"));\n    }\n    drop(repo);\n    disk\n}\n\n/// 单键提交的 6 个故障点（详见 format 模块“同步边界”）。\nfn all_crash_rules() -> [(Target, Op, u64); 6] {\n    [\n        (Target::Data, Op::Write, 1),\n        (Target::Data, Op::Sync, 1),\n        (Target::Data, Op::Write, 2),\n        (Target::Data, Op::Sync, 2),\n        (Target::Super, Op::Write, 1),\n        (Target::Super, Op::Sync, 1),\n    ]\n]\n\n/// 对“代次 base→base+1”的单键提交，在每个故障点注入断电：\n/// 提交必须报注入故障；重挂载必须严格停留在 base。\n#[test]\nfn crash_matrix_single_key_commits() {\n    for base in 0..=4u64 {\n        for (target, op, nth) in all_crash_rules() {\n            let disk = fresh_with_commits(base);\n            let key = format!(\"next{base}\");\n            let res = {\n                let mut repo = reopen(&disk);\n                repo.put_batch([(key.as_bytes(), b\"v\".as_slice())])\n            };\n            // 没有故障时不应进入本分支（这里只是占位，实际用带故障的挂载）。\n            drop(res);\n\n            // 带故障重新尝试。\n            let disk2 = fresh_with_commits(base);\n            let attempt = {\n                let st = disk2.storage(vec![FaultRule::crash(target, op, nth)]);\n                let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n                repo.put_batch([(key.as_bytes(), b\"v\".as_slice())])\n            };\n            let err = attempt.expect_err(\"注入断电后提交必须失败\");\n            assert!(err.is_injected_fault(), \"应为注入故障，实际 {err}\");\n\n            let repo = reopen(&disk2);\n            assert_eq!(\n                repo.generation(),\n                base,\n                \"base={base} 故障点={target:?}/{op:?}#{nth}：恢复代次应为 {base}\"\n            );\n            // 全部既有键完好。\n            for g in 1..=base {\n                let k = format!(\"key{g}\");\n                assert_eq!(\n                    repo.get(k.as_bytes()),\n                    Some(vec![g as u8; 4].as_slice()),\n                    \"base={base} 故障点={target:?}/{op:?}#{nth}：键 {k} 数据损坏\"\n                );\n            }\n            assert!(repo.get(key.as_bytes()).is_none(), \"崩溃的新键不得可见\");\n            let _ = disk;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 同样的 6 个故障点，对“3 键批次”提交（数据写次数增加为 4：3 LEAF + 1 ROOT）。\n#[test]\nfn crash_matrix_three_key_batch() {\n    // 批次：leaf×3, sync1, root, sync2, super write, super sync\n    let rules: [FaultRule; 8] = [\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Write, 1),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Write, 3),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Sync, 1),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Write, 4),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Sync, 2),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Super, Op::Write, 1),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Super, Op::Sync, 1),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Write, 2),\n    ];\n    for rule in rules {\n        let disk = fresh_with_commits(2);\n        let items = [\n            (b\"a\".as_slice(), b\"1\".as_slice()),\n            (b\"b\".as_slice(), b\"22\".as_slice()),\n            (b\"c\".as_slice(), b\"333\".as_slice()),\n        ];\n        let err = {\n            let mut repo = Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![rule])).unwrap();\n            repo.put_batch(items).unwrap_err()\n        };\n        assert!(err.is_injected_fault());\n        let repo = reopen(&disk);\n        assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 2);\n        assert!(repo.get(b\"a\").is_none());\n        assert!(repo.get(b\"b\").is_none());\n        assert!(repo.get(b\"c\").is_none());\n        assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"key1\"), Some([1u8; 4].as_slice()));\n    }\n}\n\n/// 半页写 keep 从 0..PAGE_SIZE 扫描：超级块页只要不是整页，恢复都必须停在旧代次。\n#[test]\nfn torn_super_page_sweep() {\n    for keep in [0usize, 1, 8, 33, 37, 38, 100, 2048, 4077, 4078, 4095] {\n        let disk = fresh_with_commits(3); // gen3 在槽1；gen4 将写槽0\n        let err = {\n            let st = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Super, 1, keep)]);\n            let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n            repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v\".as_slice())]).unwrap_err()\n        };\n        assert!(err.is_injected_fault(), \"keep={keep}\");\n        let repo = reopen(&disk);\n        assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 3, \"keep={keep} 时不应接受半新页\");\n    }\n\n    // keep == 4096：整页持久化，重挂载看到 gen4（尽管 fsync 回执丢失）。\n    let disk = fresh_with_commits(3);\n    let _ = {\n        let st = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Super, 1, 4096)]);\n        let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v\".as_slice())]).unwrap_err()\n    };\n    assert_eq!(reopen(&disk).generation(), 4);\n}\n\n/// 数据文件半页写扫描：LEAF/ROOT 任意位置撕裂都必须停留在旧代次，\n/// 且数据文件中残留的垃圾前缀不得让挂载失败。\n#[test]\nfn torn_data_record_sweep() {\n    // gen3→4 单键：写1=LEAF，写2=ROOT；keep 从 0 到记录全长-1。\n    for write_nth in [1u64, 2] {\n        for keep in [0usize, 1, 3, 5, 9, 15, 16, 20] {\n            let disk = fresh_with_commits(3);\n            let err = {\n                let st = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Data, write_nth, keep)]);\n                let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n                repo.put_batch([(b\"g4\".as_slice(), &[4u8; 8])]).unwrap_err()\n            };\n            assert!(err.is_injected_fault(), \"写#{write_nth} keep={keep}\");\n            let repo = reopen(&disk);\n            assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 3, \"写#{write_nth} keep={keep}\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 删除操作本身也是一次新代次提交，崩溃语义与写入一致。\n#[test]\nfn delete_is_a_commit_and_recovers() {\n    let disk = fresh_with_commits(2);\n    // 删除 key1 时在超级块 fsync 前崩溃 → key1 仍在。\n    let err = {\n        let st = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::crash(Target::Super, Op::Sync, 1)]);\n        let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n        repo.delete_batch([b\"key1\"]).unwrap_err()\n    };\n    assert!(err.is_injected_fault());\n    let repo = reopen(&disk);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 2);\n    assert!(repo.get(b\"key1\").is_some());\n\n    // 无故障重试删除 → 新代次，key1 消失，key2 保留。\n    {\n        let mut repo = reopen(&disk);\n        let snap = repo.delete_batch([b\"key1\"]).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(snap.generation, 3);\n    }\n    let repo = reopen(&disk);\n    assert!(repo.get(b\"key1\").is_none());\n    assert!(repo.get(b\"key2\").is_some());\n}\n\n/// 覆盖更新：旧 LEAF 成为垃圾但仍在文件中；ROOT 只引用最新 LEAF。\n#[test]\nfn overwrite_grows_data_but_only_latest_is_reachable() {\n    let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n    let data_lens: Vec<usize>;\n    {\n        let mut repo = Repository::format(disk.storage(vec![])).unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"short\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n        let l1 = disk.stable_data().len();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"a-much-longer-value\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n        let l2 = disk.stable_data().len();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"x\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n        let l3 = disk.stable_data().len();\n        data_lens = vec![l1, l2, l3];\n    }\n    assert!(data_lens[0] < data_lens[1] && data_lens[1] < data_lens[2], \"只追加，文件单调增长\");\n    let repo = reopen(&disk);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 3);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"k\"), Some(b\"x\".as_slice()));\n}\n\n/// selftest 报告必须全绿（防止用例之间状态串扰）。\n#[test]\nfn selftest_report_all_pass() {\n    let report = selftest::run();\n    assert!(\n        report.all_passed(),\n        \"自检存在失败项:\\n{}\",\n        report\n            .cases\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|c| !c.passed)\n            .map(|c| format!(\"  FAIL {} — {}\", c.name, c.detail))\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\"\\n\")\n    );\n    assert_eq!(report.cases.len(), 19);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_fault_kind_is_observable() {\n    let disk = fresh_with_commits(1);\n    let err = {\n        let st = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Data, 1, 7)]);\n        let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"z\".as_slice(), b\"z\".as_slice())]).unwrap_err()\n    };\n    let f = err.injected_fault().expect(\"应能取出注入故障信息\");\n    assert_eq!(f.target, Target::Data);\n    assert_eq!(f.op, Op::Write);\n    assert!(matches!(f.kind, FaultKind::TearWrite(7)));\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_59c567e8ef35343a5455f88a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1242,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":90936,"output_tokens":3228,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_udkgmkfw2x4rizwoc3bet3cp":{"content":"//! assert!(err.is_injected_fault(), \"应为注入故障，实际 {err}\");\n\n            let repo = reopen(&disk);\n            assert_eq!(\n                repo.generation(),\n                base,\n                \"base={base} 故障点={target:?}/{op:?}#{nth}：恢复代次应为 {base}\"\n            );\n            // 全部既有键完好。\n            for g in 1..=base {\n                let k = format!(\"key{g}\");\n                assert_eq!(\n                    repo.get(k.as_bytes()),\n                    Some(vec![g as u8; 4].as_slice()),\n                    \"base={base} 故障点={target:?}/{op:?}#{nth}：键 {k} 数据损坏\"\n                );\n            }\n            assert!(repo.get(key.as_bytes()).is_none(), \"崩溃的新键不得可见\");\n        }\n    }\n}","originalFile":"//! 集成测试：在模拟磁盘上穷举“多次提交 × 每个故障点”，并覆盖\n//! 多键批次、删除、代次单调性等额外不变量。\n\nuse dual_superblock::io_layer::{FaultKind, FaultRule, Op, SimDisk, Target};\nuse dual_superblock::selftest;\nuse dual_superblock::store::Repository;\n\nfn reopen(disk: &SimDisk) -> Repository<dual_superblock::io_layer::SimStorage> {\n    Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![])).expect(\"重新挂载不应失败\")\n}\n\nfn fresh_with_commits(n: u64) -> SimDisk {\n    let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n    let mut repo = Repository::format(disk.storage(vec![])).unwrap();\n    for g in 1..=n {\n        let key = format!(\"key{g}\");\n        repo.put_batch([(key.as_bytes(), vec![g as u8; 4].as_slice())])\n            .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!(\"提交代次 {g} 失败: {e}\"));\n    }\n    drop(repo);\n    disk\n}\n\n/// 单键提交的 6 个故障点（详见 format 模块“同步边界”）。\nfn all_crash_rules() -> [(Target, Op, u64); 6] {\n    [\n        (Target::Data, Op::Write, 1),\n        (Target::Data, Op::Sync, 1),\n        (Target::Data, Op::Write, 2),\n        (Target::Data, Op::Sync, 2),\n        (Target::Super, Op::Write, 1),\n        (Target::Super, Op::Sync, 1),\n    ]\n]\n\n/// 对“代次 base→base+1”的单键提交，在每个故障点注入断电：\n/// 提交必须报注入故障；重挂载必须严格停留在 base。\n#[test]\nfn crash_matrix_single_key_commits() {\n    for base in 0..=4u64 {\n        for (target, op, nth) in all_crash_rules() {\n            let disk = fresh_with_commits(base);\n            let key = format!(\"next{base}\");\n            let res = {\n                let mut repo = reopen(&disk);\n                repo.put_batch([(key.as_bytes(), b\"v\".as_slice())])\n            };\n            // 没有故障时不应进入本分支（这里只是占位，实际用带故障的挂载）。\n            drop(res);\n\n            // 带故障重新尝试。\n            let disk2 = fresh_with_commits(base);\n            let attempt = {\n                let st = disk2.storage(vec![FaultRule::crash(target, op, nth)]);\n                let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n                repo.put_batch([(key.as_bytes(), b\"v\".as_slice())])\n            };\n            let err = attempt.expect_err(\"注入断电后提交必须失败\");\n            assert!(err.is_injected_fault(), \"应为注入故障，实际 {err}\");\n\n            let repo = reopen(&disk2);\n            assert_eq!(\n                repo.generation(),\n                base,\n                \"base={base} 故障点={target:?}/{op:?}#{nth}：恢复代次应为 {base}\"\n            );\n            // 全部既有键完好。\n            for g in 1..=base {\n                let k = format!(\"key{g}\");\n                assert_eq!(\n                    repo.get(k.as_bytes()),\n                    Some(vec![g as u8; 4].as_slice()),\n                    \"base={base} 故障点={target:?}/{op:?}#{nth}：键 {k} 数据损坏\"\n                );\n            }\n            assert!(repo.get(key.as_bytes()).is_none(), \"崩溃的新键不得可见\");\n            let _ = disk;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 同样的 6 个故障点，对“3 键批次”提交（数据写次数增加为 4：3 LEAF + 1 ROOT）。\n#[test]\nfn crash_matrix_three_key_batch() {\n    // 批次：leaf×3, sync1, root, sync2, super write, super sync\n    let rules: [FaultRule; 8] = [\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Write, 1),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Write, 3),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Sync, 1),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Write, 4),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Sync, 2),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Super, Op::Write, 1),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Super, Op::Sync, 1),\n        FaultRule::crash(Target::Data, Op::Write, 2),\n    ];\n    for rule in rules {\n        let disk = fresh_with_commits(2);\n        let items = [\n            (b\"a\".as_slice(), b\"1\".as_slice()),\n            (b\"b\".as_slice(), b\"22\".as_slice()),\n            (b\"c\".as_slice(), b\"333\".as_slice()),\n        ];\n        let err = {\n            let mut repo = Repository::open(disk.storage(vec![rule])).unwrap();\n            repo.put_batch(items).unwrap_err()\n        };\n        assert!(err.is_injected_fault());\n        let repo = reopen(&disk);\n        assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 2);\n        assert!(repo.get(b\"a\").is_none());\n        assert!(repo.get(b\"b\").is_none());\n        assert!(repo.get(b\"c\").is_none());\n        assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"key1\"), Some([1u8; 4].as_slice()));\n    }\n}\n\n/// 半页写 keep 从 0..PAGE_SIZE 扫描：超级块页只要不是整页，恢复都必须停在旧代次。\n#[test]\nfn torn_super_page_sweep() {\n    for keep in [0usize, 1, 8, 33, 37, 38, 100, 2048, 4077, 4078, 4095] {\n        let disk = fresh_with_commits(3); // gen3 在槽1；gen4 将写槽0\n        let err = {\n            let st = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Super, 1, keep)]);\n            let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n            repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v\".as_slice())]).unwrap_err()\n        };\n        assert!(err.is_injected_fault(), \"keep={keep}\");\n        let repo = reopen(&disk);\n        assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 3, \"keep={keep} 时不应接受半新页\");\n    }\n\n    // keep == 4096：整页持久化，重挂载看到 gen4（尽管 fsync 回执丢失）。\n    let disk = fresh_with_commits(3);\n    let _ = {\n        let st = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Super, 1, 4096)]);\n        let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v\".as_slice())]).unwrap_err()\n    };\n    assert_eq!(reopen(&disk).generation(), 4);\n}\n\n/// 数据文件半页写扫描：LEAF/ROOT 任意位置撕裂都必须停留在旧代次，\n/// 且数据文件中残留的垃圾前缀不得让挂载失败。\n#[test]\nfn torn_data_record_sweep() {\n    // gen3→4 单键：写1=LEAF，写2=ROOT；keep 从 0 到记录全长-1。\n    for write_nth in [1u64, 2] {\n        for keep in [0usize, 1, 3, 5, 9, 15, 16, 20] {\n            let disk = fresh_with_commits(3);\n            let err = {\n                let st = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::tear(Target::Data, write_nth, keep)]);\n                let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n                repo.put_batch([(b\"g4\".as_slice(), &[4u8; 8])]).unwrap_err()\n            };\n            assert!(err.is_injected_fault(), \"写#{write_nth} keep={keep}\");\n            let repo = reopen(&disk);\n            assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 3, \"写#{write_nth} keep={keep}\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 删除操作本身也是一次新代次提交，崩溃语义与写入一致。\n#[test]\nfn delete_is_a_commit_and_recovers() {\n    let disk = fresh_with_commits(2);\n    // 删除 key1 时在超级块 fsync 前崩溃 → key1 仍在。\n    let err = {\n        let st = disk.storage(vec![FaultRule::crash(Target::Super, Op::Sync, 1)]);\n        let mut repo = Repository::open(st).unwrap();\n        repo.delete_batch([b\"key1\"]).unwrap_err()\n    };\n    assert!(err.is_injected_fault());\n    let repo = reopen(&disk);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 2);\n    assert!(repo.get(b\"key1\").is_some());\n\n    // 无故障重试删除 → 新代次，key1 消失，key2 保留。\n    {\n        let mut repo = reopen(&disk);\n        let snap = repo.delete_batch([b\"key1\"]).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(snap.generation, 3);\n    }\n    let repo = reopen(&disk);\n    assert!(repo.get(b\"key1\").is_none());\n    assert!(repo.get(b\"key2\").is_some());\n}\n\n/// 覆盖更新：旧 LEAF 成为垃圾但仍在文件中；ROOT 只引用最新 LEAF。\n#[test]\nfn overwrite_grows_data_but_only_latest_is_reachable() {\n    let disk = SimDisk::fresh();\n    let data_lens: Vec<usize>;\n    {\n        let mut repo = Repository::format(disk.storage(vec![])).unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), 真实文件后端集成测试：跑在真实 fsync 上，并通过**进程外手段**\n//! （直接截断/翻转文件字节）模拟介质损坏，验证引擎能在真实目录上恢复。\n\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse dual_superblock::format::{self, PAGE_SIZE};\nuse dual_superblock::io_layer::RealStorage;\nuse dual_superblock::store::Repository;\n\nfn temp_dir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let mut d = std::env::temp_dir();\n    let unique = format!(\n        \"dual-sb-{tag}-{}-{}\",\n        std::process::id(),\n        std::time::SystemTime::now()\n            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n            .unwrap()\n            .as_nanos()\n    );\n    d.push(unique);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();\n    d\n}\n\nfn open_repo(dir: &Path) -> Repository<RealStorage> {\n    let st = RealStorage::open(dir).expect(\"打开真实文件失败\");\n    Repository::open(st).expect(\"恢复真实仓库失败\")\n}\n\nfn format_repo(dir: &Path) -> Repository<RealStorage> {\n    RealStorage::create_files(dir).unwrap();\n    let st = RealStorage::open(dir).unwrap();\n    Repository::format(st).unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_clean_roundtrip_and_reopen() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"clean\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n        repo.put_batch([\n            (\"alpha\".as_bytes(), \"one\".as_bytes()),\n            (\"beta\".as_bytes(), \"two\".as_bytes()),\n        ])\n        .unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(\"gamma\".as_bytes(), \"三\".as_bytes())]).unwrap();\n        repo.delete_batch([b\"alpha\"]).unwrap();\n    }\n    // 重新打开（新的 RealStorage 句柄，等同于进程重启）。\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 3);\n    assert!(repo.get(b\"alpha\").is_none());\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"beta\"), Some(\"two\".as_bytes()));\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"gamma\"), Some(\"三\".as_bytes()));\n\n    // 磁盘文件尺寸不变量：超级块固定 8192。\n    let sf_len = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE)).unwrap().len();\n    assert_eq!(sf_len, (2 * PAGE_SIZE) as u64);\n    let data_len = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(format::DATA_FILE)).unwrap().len();\n    assert!(data_len > 0);\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_torn_super_slot_falls_back() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"torn-sb\");\n    // 写 2 代次：gen1 在槽1，gen2 在槽0。\n    {\n        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v1\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v2\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n    }\n    // 介质损坏：把槽0（gen2）页尾尾戳区域翻转，整页 CRC 立即失效；\n    // 槽1（gen1）保持完好。\n    let sf_path = dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE);\n    let mut sf = std::fs::read(&sf_path).unwrap();\n    let trailer = sf.len() - 6; // 落在尾戳内部\n    sf[trailer] ^= 0xFF;\n    std::fs::write(&sf_path, &sf).unwrap();\n\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 1, \"应回退到槽1中的代次1\");\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"k\"), Some(b\"v1\".as_slice()));\n\n    // 回退后仍可继续写入：代次从 1 推进。\n    let mut repo = repo;\n    let snap = repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v3\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(snap.generation, 2);\n    drop(repo);\n    assert_eq!(open_repo(&dir).generation(), 2);\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_both_slots_corrupt_is_an_error_not_silence() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"both-bad\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_bytes(), b\"v1\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n    }\n    let sf_path = dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE);\n    let mut sf = std::fs::read(&sf_path).unwrap();\n    sf[0] ^= 0xFF; // 槽0 魔数\n    sf[PAGE_SIZE] ^= 0xFF; // 槽1 魔数\n    std::fs::write(&sf_path, &sf).unwrap();\n\n    let st = RealStorage::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    let err = Repository::open(st).expect_err(\"两槽皆坏必须报错\");\n    let msg = err.to_string();\n    assert!(msg.contains(\"两个超级块槽位均无效\"), \"实际: {msg}\");\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_truncated_data_tail_is_tolerated() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"trunc-data\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"a\".as_slice(), b\"1\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"b\".as_slice(), b\"2\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n    }\n    // 介质在尾部丢了 7 字节（最后一次提交的记录被截断），同时把槽0(gen2)\n    // 的超级块也毁掉——此时引擎必须回退到 gen1，而不是崩溃或读越界。\n    let data_path = dir.join(format::DATA_FILE);\n    let meta = std::fs::metadata(&data_path).unwrap();\n    let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).open(&data_path).unwrap();\n    use std::io::Write;\n    f.set_len(meta.len() - 7).unwrap();\n    f.flush().unwrap();\n    drop(f);\n\n    let sf_path = dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE);\n    let mut sf = std::fs::read(&sf_path).unwrap();\n    sf[PAGE_SIZE - 2] ^= 0xFF; // 毁掉槽0尾戳 → 整页 CRC 失效\n    std::fs::write(&sf_path, sf).unwrap();\n\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"a\"), Some(b\"1\".as_slice()));\n    assert!(repo.get(b\"b\").is_none());\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_rejects_pointer_beyond_eof() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"oob\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"safe\".as_bytes(), b\"ok\".as_slice())]).unwrap(); // gen1 → 槽1\n    }\n    // 在槽0伪造一个高代次超级块，根指针指向远超 EOF 的位置（页 CRC/尾戳都合法）。\n    let bogus = format::SuperBlock {\n        generation: 42,\n        root: format::Ptr { offset: 99_999_999, len: 64, crc: 0xCAFE },\n    };\n    let sf_path = dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE);\n    let mut sf = std::fs::read(&sf_path).unwrap();\n    let page = format::encode_super_page(&bogus);\n    sf[0..PAGE_SIZE].copy_from_slice(&page);\n    std::fs::write(&sf_path, sf).unwrap();\n\n    // 越界候选必须被拒绝并回退 gen1，而不是 panic / 读越界。\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"safe\"), Some(b\"ok\".as_slice()));\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_open_unformatted_dir_is_notformatted() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"unformatted\");\n    // 目录存在但无文件：open 直接报 NotFound（来自 I/O 层）。\n    let err = RealStorage::open(&dir).unwrap_err();\n    assert_eq!(err.kind(), std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound);\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_6178f8c844d71c92cfc8b2e2","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1285,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":95032,"output_tokens":2213,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_13n26b6u3vj37vt8kuvk7mrw":{"content":"//! back)"}]},"uuid":"c7dba835-af75-4a66-88c3-9018d6010a37","timestamp":"2026-09-23T01:57:18.248Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a/tests/real_files.rs","content":"//! 真实文件后端集成测试：跑在真实 fsync 上，并通过**进程外手段**\n//! （直接截断/翻转文件字节）模拟介质损坏，验证引擎能在真实目录上恢复。\n\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse dual_superblock::format::{self, PAGE_SIZE};\nuse dual_superblock::io_layer::RealStorage;\nuse dual_superblock::store::Repository;\n\nfn temp_dir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let mut d = std::env::temp_dir();\n    let unique = format!(\n        \"dual-sb-{tag}-{}-{}\",\n        std::process::id(),\n        std::time::SystemTime::now()\n            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n            .unwrap()\n            .as_nanos()\n    );\n    d.push(unique);\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();\n    d\n}\n\nfn open_repo(dir: &Path) -> Repository<RealStorage> {\n    let st = RealStorage::open(dir).expect(\"打开真实文件失败\");\n    Repository::open(st).expect(\"恢复真实仓库失败\")\n}\n\nfn format_repo(dir: &Path) -> Repository<RealStorage> {\n    RealStorage::create_files(dir).unwrap();\n    let st = RealStorage::open(dir).unwrap();\n    Repository::format(st).unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_clean_roundtrip_and_reopen() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"clean\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n        repo.put_batch([\n            (\"alpha\".as_bytes(), \"one\".as_bytes()),\n            (\"beta\".as_bytes(), \"two\".as_bytes()),\n        ])\n        .unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(\"gamma\".as_bytes(), \"三\".as_bytes())]).unwrap();\n        repo.delete_batch([b\"alpha\"]).unwrap();\n    }\n    // 重新打开（新的 RealStorage 句柄，等同于进程重启）。\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 3);\n    assert!(repo.get(b\"alpha\").is_none());\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"beta\"), Some(\"two\".as_bytes()));\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"gamma\"), Some(\"三\".as_bytes()));\n\n    // 磁盘文件尺寸不变量：超级块固定 8192。\n    let sf_len = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE)).unwrap().len();\n    assert_eq!(sf_len, (2 * PAGE_SIZE) as u64);\n    let data_len = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(format::DATA_FILE)).unwrap().len();\n    assert!(data_len > 0);\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_torn_super_slot_falls_back() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"torn-sb\");\n    // 写 2 代次：gen1 在槽1，gen2 在槽0。\n    {\n        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v1\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v2\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n    }\n    // 介质损坏：把槽0（gen2）页尾尾戳区域翻转，整页 CRC 立即失效；\n    // 槽1（gen1）保持完好。\n    let sf_path = dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE);\n    let mut sf = std::fs::read(&sf_path).unwrap();\n    let trailer = sf.len() - 6; // 落在尾戳内部\n    sf[trailer] ^= 0xFF;\n    std::fs::write(&sf_path, &sf).unwrap();\n\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 1, \"应回退到槽1中的代次1\");\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"k\"), Some(b\"v1\".as_slice()));\n\n    // 回退后仍可继续写入：代次从 1 推进。\n    let mut repo = repo;\n    let snap = repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v3\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(snap.generation, 2);\n    drop(repo);\n    assert_eq!(open_repo(&dir).generation(), 2);\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_both_slots_corrupt_is_an_error_not_silence() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"both-bad\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_bytes(), b\"v1\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n    }\n    let sf_path = dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE);\n    let mut sf = std::fs::read(&sf_path).unwrap();\n    sf[0] ^= 0xFF; // 槽0 魔数\n    sf[PAGE_SIZE] ^= 0xFF; // 槽1 魔数\n    std::fs::write(&sf_path, &sf).unwrap();\n\n    let st = RealStorage::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    let err = Repository::open(st).expect_err(\"两槽皆坏必须报错\");\n    let msg = err.to_string();\n    assert!(msg.contains(\"两个超级块槽位均无效\"), \"实际: {msg}\");\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_truncated_data_tail_is_tolerated() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"trunc-data\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"a\".as_slice(), b\"1\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"b\".as_slice(), b\"2\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n    }\n    // 介质在尾部丢了 7 字节（最后一次提交的记录被截断），同时把槽0(gen2)\n    // 的超级块也毁掉——此时引擎必须回退到 gen1，而不是崩溃或读越界。\n    let data_path = dir.join(format::DATA_FILE);\n    let meta = std::fs::metadata(&data_path).unwrap();\n    let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).open(&data_path).unwrap();\n    use std::io::Write;\n    f.set_len(meta.len() - 7).unwrap();\n    f.flush().unwrap();\n    drop(f);\n\n    let sf_path = dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE);\n    let mut sf = std::fs::read(&sf_path).unwrap();\n    sf[PAGE_SIZE - 2] ^= 0xFF; // 毁掉槽0尾戳 → 整页 CRC 失效\n    std::fs::write(&sf_path, sf).unwrap();\n\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"a\"), Some(b\"1\".as_slice()));\n    assert!(repo.get(b\"b\").is_none());\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_rejects_pointer_beyond_eof() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"oob\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n        repo.put_batch([(b\"safe\".as_bytes(), b\"ok\".as_slice())]).unwrap(); // gen1 → 槽1\n    }\n    // 在槽0伪造一个高代次超级块，根指针指向远超 EOF 的位置（页 CRC/尾戳都合法）。\n    let bogus = format::SuperBlock {\n        generation: 42,\n        root: format::Ptr { offset: 99_999_999, len: 64, crc: 0xCAFE },\n    };\n    let sf_path = dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE);\n    let mut sf = std::fs::read(&sf_path).unwrap();\n    let page = format::encode_super_page(&bogus);\n    sf[0..PAGE_SIZE].copy_from_slice(&page);\n    std::fs::write(&sf_path, sf).unwrap();\n\n    // 越界候选必须被拒绝并回退 gen1，而不是 panic / 读越界。\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"safe\"), Some(b\"ok\".as_slice()));\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_file_open_unformatted_dir_is_notformatted() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"unformatted\");\n    // 目录存在但无文件：open 直接报 NotFound（来自 I/O 层）。\n    let err = RealStorage::open(&dir).unwrap_err();\n    assert_eq!(err.kind(), std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound);\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"078362ae-ef81-4ee9-b4c4-2e4dfe07e90a","session_id":"aa155883-6d0d-48f5-bfbf-9f0daaa5a572","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/a","sessionId":"aa155883-6d0d-48f5-bfbf-9f0daaa5a572","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp1-a","slug":"tender-tinkering-wave"}

.unwrap()\n18\t            .as_nanos()\n19\t    );\n20\t    d.push(unique);\n21\t    std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();\n22\t    d\n23\t}\n24\t\n25\tfn open_repo(dir: &Path) -> Repository<RealStorage> {\n26\t    let st = RealStorage::open(dir).expect(\"打开真实文件失败\");\n27\t    Repository::open(st).expect(\"恢复真实仓库失败\")\n28\t}\n29\t\n30\tfn format_repo(dir: &Path) -> Repository<RealStorage> {\n31\t    RealStorage::create_files(dir).unwrap();\n32\t    let st = RealStorage::open(dir).unwrap();\n33\t    Repository::format(st).unwrap()\n34\t}\n35\t\n36\t#[test]\n37\tfn real_file_clean_roundtrip_and_reopen() {\n38\t    let dir = temp_dir(\"clean\");\n39\t    {\n40\t        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n41\t        repo.put_batch([\n42\t            (\"alpha\".as_bytes(), \"one\".as_bytes()),\n43\t            (\"beta\".as_bytes(), \"two\".as_bytes()),\n44\t        ])\n45\t        .unwrap();\n46\t        repo.put_batch([(\"gamma\".as_bytes(), \"三\".as_bytes())]).unwrap();\n47\t        repo.delete_batch([b\"alpha\"]).unwrap();\n48\t    }\n49\t    // 重新打开（新的 RealStorage 句柄，等同于进程重启）。\n50\t    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n51\t    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 3);\n52\t    assert!(repo.get(b\"alpha\").is_none());\n53\t    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"beta\"), Some(\"two\".as_bytes()));\n54\t    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"gamma\"), Some(\"三\".as_bytes()));\n55\t\n56\t    // 磁盘文件尺寸不变量：超级块固定 8192。\n57\t    let sf_len = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE)).unwrap().len();\n58\t    assert_eq!(sf_len, (2 * PAGE_SIZE) as u64);\n59\t    let data_len = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(format::DATA_FILE)).unwrap().len();\n60\t    assert!(data_len > 0);\n61\t\n62\t    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n63\t}\n64\t\n65\t#[test]\n66\tfn real_file_torn_super_slot_falls_back() {\n67\t    let dir = temp_dir(\"torn-sb\");\n68\t    // 写 2 代次：gen1 在槽1，gen2 在槽0。\n69\t    {\n70\t        let mut repo = format_repo(&dir);\n71\t        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v1\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n72\t        repo.put_batch([(b\"k\".as_slice(), b\"v2\".as_slice())]).unwrap();\n73\t    }\n74\t    // 介质损坏：把槽0（gen2）页尾尾戳区域翻转，整页 CRC 立即失效；\n75\t    // 槽1（gen1）保持完好。\n76\t    let sf_path = dir.join(format::SUPER_FILE);\n77\t    let mut sf = std::fs::read(&sf_path).unwrap();\n78\t    let trailer = sf.len() - 6; // 落在尾戳内部\n79\t    sf[trailer] ^= 0xFF;\n80\t    std::fs::write(&sf_path, &sf).unwrap();\n81\t\n82\t    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n83\t    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 1, \"应回退到槽1中的代次1\");\n84\t std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n94\t}\n95\t\n96\t#[test]\n97\tfn real_file_both_slots_corrupt_is_an_error_not_silence() {\n98\t    let dir = temp_dir(\"both-bad\");\n99\t    {\n100\t        let
